Policy ID: `core-rules-source-policy:maintained-direct-app-data-mirrors:2026-09-02`.

40k.app and [Game Datamissions](https://game-datamissions.com/11th/rules/changelog) are co-equal non-affiliated maintained App-data mirrors. They are not Games Workshop. The live sites are not runtime inputs. Maintained App wording supersedes an older PDF. If co-versioned mirrors disagree for one stable rule ID and App-data version, loading fails closed until an official-App comparison.

[Architecture status](../ARCHITECTURE_V2.md) · [Faction rules roadmap](FACTION_RULES_REMEDIATION_ROADMAP.md) · [Source policy](CORE_RULES_SOURCE_POLICY.md)

## Where this stands

This roadmap is the closure inventory for Warhammer 40,000 11th Edition Core Rules categories 01–25. Orders 1–101 are merged. Order 101 / P03F restores movement selection after failed complete setup; see [scope](ORDER_101_SCOPE_PLAN.md) and merged [PR #524](https://github.com/SobolGaming/Warhammer_40k_AI/pull/524), verified on main at `38ce2265b81f2c0b2c9c668dae7536c239095193`. Its [scope and limits](ORDER_97_SCOPE_PLAN.md) and [clause report](ORDER_97_EVIDENCE_REPORT.md) identify additional source and gameplay prerequisites below. Faction work is out of scope here and waits on `PFINAL`; see the [faction roadmap](FACTION_RULES_REMEDIATION_ROADMAP.md).

## Authority

Policy ID: `core-rules-source-policy:maintained-direct-app-data-mirrors:2026-09-02`.

40k.app and [Game Datamissions](https://game-datamissions.com/11th/rules/changelog) are co-equal non-affiliated maintained App-data mirrors. They are not Games Workshop. The live sites are not runtime inputs. Maintained App wording supersedes an older PDF. If co-versioned mirrors disagree for one stable rule ID and App-data version, loading fails closed until an official-App comparison.

Every implementation observation pins provider, URL, App-data version or observation timestamp, transcription SHA-256, and source-observation fingerprint. `S-MIRRORS` (Order 11, PR #416) is that governance gate. P00 is PR #405 and changes provenance only.

The retained official Core Rules PDF SHA-256 is `f6a2443a44627ac5f0ef08407d29aa5ec7e97339998f05bc35f3ae37bf276833`. App-data 931 (2026-08-26) is 18 distinct obligations. App-data 946 (2026-09-02) adds 18.04.01 Rapid Disembark. Both are rows in the table below.

Only one remediation implementation PR is open at a time. It is reviewed and merged before the next implementation starts. The negative audits enumerate discovered follow-ups together; they do not implement or close them.

|---|---|

| `APP-DRIFT` | A repository row or older PDF differs from current App wording and must be narrowed |

"""Exact migration proof cannot exempt arbitrary source or rewrite measurements."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

import pytest
from tools import cumulative_preservation as migration
from tools import performance_policy as policy
from tools import performance_qualification_successor as successor
from tools import performance_reconstruction_campaign as reconstruction
from tools import performance_tool_inputs as original
from tools import performance_tool_inputs_v2 as fresh

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def read_archive() -> dict[str, object]:
    return migration.read_archive(ROOT)


def _inputs(archive: dict[str, object], name: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    return cast(dict[str, str], archive[name])


def _controls() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {p: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in migration.CONTROLS}


def _current(archive: dict[str, object]) -> tuple[dict[str, str], dict[str, str]]:
    return migration.expected_inputs(ROOT)


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def copied_migration(tmp_path_factory: pytest.TempPathFactory) -> Path:
    root = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("category-applicability")
    # Copy exact live inputs, including transitive fixtures and the new evidence
    # namespace. A read-only Git pointer retains authenticated object identity.
    shutil.copytree(
        ROOT,
        root,
        dirs_exist_ok=True,
        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(
            ".git", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache"
        ),
    )
    git_dir = (
        subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--absolute-git-dir"], cwd=ROOT)
        .decode()
        .strip()
    )
    (root / ".git").write_text("gitdir: " + git_dir + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def test_actual_current_and_original_git_inventories_match_finite_cohorts() -> None:
    archive = read_archive()
    assert migration.applies(
        base=migration.BASE, runtime_id=reconstruction.RUNTIME, family="reconstruction"
    )
    current, tools = _current(archive)
    actual_current, actual_tools = migration.assessment_map_inputs(
        ROOT,
        archive=archive,
        current=policy.runtime_inputs(ROOT),
        tools=migration.current_tool_inventory(ROOT),
    )
    assert actual_current == current
    assert actual_tools == tools
    assert (
        migration.measured_snapshot(ROOT, migration.MEASURED)
        == archive["TOOL_MEASURED_INPUTS.json.txt"]
    )
    assert migration.measured_snapshot(ROOT, migration.BASE) == archive["TOOL_BASE_INPUTS.json.txt"]
    migration.verify_current_inventory(
        ROOT, archive=archive, current=current, tools=tools, controls=_controls()
    )
    assert (
        len(migration.verify_external_reads(ROOT, policy.object_value(archive[migration.EXTERNAL])))
        == 64
    )


def test_measured_binding_rebuilds_without_using_report_exclusions() -> None:
    archive = read_archive()
    before = migration.measured_snapshot(ROOT, migration.BASE)
    after = migration.measured_snapshot(ROOT, migration.MEASURED)
    harness = {p: after[p] for p in fresh.HARNESS}
    result = fresh.classify_inputs(
        spec=cast(dict[str, object], archive["MEASURED_ROLE_SPEC.json.txt"]),
        base=before,
        head=after,
        base_revision=migration.BASE,
        head_revision=migration.MEASURED,
        head_input_digest=original.digest(archive["POLICY_MEASURED_INPUTS.json.txt"]),
        harness_base=harness,
        harness_head=harness,
    )
    assert result == archive["MEASURED_BINDING.json.txt"]


def test_original_reconstruction_bridge_remains_separate() -> None:
    archive = read_archive()
    report = policy.read_object(ROOT / reconstruction.REPORT)
    measured, receipt = reconstruction.retained_inputs(
        ROOT,
        current=_inputs(archive, "POLICY_MEASURED_INPUTS.json.txt"),
        report=report,
        base=migration.BASE,
        runtime_id=reconstruction.RUNTIME,
    )
    assert original.digest(measured) == reconstruction.MEASURED_DIGEST
    assert original.digest(report) == reconstruction.REPORT_DIGEST
    assert len(receipt) == 64
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unreviewed"):
        reconstruction.retained_inputs(
            ROOT,
            current=_current(archive)[0],
            report=report,
            base=migration.BASE,
            runtime_id=reconstruction.RUNTIME,
        )


def test_direct_v2_api_still_rejects_migrated_current_source(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # The legacy API requires actual worker ancestry. A deliberately dirty
    # checkout at that genuine historical commit reaches its separate inventory
    # refusal; the cumulative qualification HEAD is never reparented or relabeled.
    root = tmp_path / "historical-dirty-checkout"
    shutil.copytree(
        ROOT,
        root,
        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(
            ".git", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache"
        ),
    )
    shutil.copytree(ROOT / ".git", root / ".git")
    subprocess.run(
        ["git", "update-ref", "--no-deref", "HEAD", migration.MEASURED], cwd=root, check=True
    )
    subprocess.run(["git", "read-tree", migration.MEASURED], cwd=root, check=True)
    assert (
        subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=root).decode().strip()
        == migration.MEASURED
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="do not equal the current source inventory"):
        original.comparison_inputs(
            root,
            base=migration.BASE,
            family=original.FAMILY,
            head_input_digest=original.digest(policy.runtime_inputs(root)),
            measured_head=migration.MEASURED,
            schema=fresh.SCHEMA,
        )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("inventory", ["policy", "tools"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["runtime", "lock", "driver", "extra", "remove", "control"])
def test_arbitrary_input_drift_is_not_a_migration(
    copied_migration: Path, inventory: str, mutation: str
) -> None:
    archive = read_archive()
    current, tools = _current(archive)
    target = current if inventory == "policy" else tools
    names = {
        "runtime": fresh.RUNTIME,
        "lock": "uv.lock",
        "driver": "scripts/measure_ingress_reconstruction.py",
        "extra": "tests/unreviewed_source.py",
        "remove": "tests/conftest.py",
        "control": "scripts/check_performance_policy.py",
    }
    if mutation == "remove":
        target.pop(names[mutation])
    else:
        target[names[mutation]] = "f" * 64
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="finite migration cohort"):
        migration.verify_current_inventory(
            copied_migration, archive=archive, current=current, tools=tools, controls=_controls()
        )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "kind", ["successor", "archive", "reader", "mapping", "shard", "inventory"]
)
def test_real_file_tampering_is_rejected_after_warm_verification(
    copied_migration: Path, kind: str
) -> None:
    archive = read_archive()
    current, tools = _current(archive)
    files = _inputs(archive, "MIGRATION_FILES.json.txt")
    choices = {
        "successor": next(p for p in files if p.startswith("tests/rules") and "/test_" in p),
        "archive": next(p for p in files if "/baseline/" in p),
        "reader": "tests/category_migration_preservation.py",
        "mapping": "data/source_audits/category_migration/preservation.json",
        "shard": "ci/test_shards/shard-1.txt",
        "inventory": "data/source_audits/order135/current-inventory-category-migration.json",
    }
    migration.verify_current_inventory(
        copied_migration, archive=archive, current=current, tools=tools, controls=_controls()
    )
    path = copied_migration / choices[kind]
    before = path.read_bytes()
    try:
        path.write_bytes(before + b"\n# changed\n")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Reviewed migration source/data changed"):
            migration.verify_current_inventory(
                copied_migration,
                archive=archive,
                current=current,
                tools=tools,
                controls=_controls(),
            )
    finally:
        path.write_bytes(before)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["omit", "extra", "repin", "member"])
def testread_archive_manifest_cannot_be_rewritten(copied_migration: Path, mutation: str) -> None:
    directory = copied_migration / migration.ARCHIVE
    manifest = directory / "INVENTORY.json.txt"
    target = directory / "EXACT_INPUT_DELTAS.json.txt"
    before_manifest, before_target = manifest.read_bytes(), target.read_bytes()
    extra = directory / "unreviewed.txt"
    try:
        if mutation == "omit":
            target.unlink()
        elif mutation == "extra":
            extra.write_text("unreviewed", encoding="utf-8")
        else:
            target.write_bytes(before_target + b" ")
            if mutation == "repin":
                data = json.loads(before_manifest)
                data[target.name] = hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                manifest.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"migration|Migration"):
            migration.read_archive(copied_migration)
    finally:
        manifest.write_bytes(before_manifest)
        target.write_bytes(before_target)
        if extra.exists():
            extra.unlink()

def test_unexpected_membership_cannot_hide_outside_selected_inputs(
    copied_migration: Path, mutation: str
) -> None:
    archive = read_archive()
    current, tools = _current(archive)

def test_diff_binding_includes_untracked_and_deleted_files_and_only_excludes_assessment(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    def git(*args: str) -> str:
        return subprocess.check_output(
            [
                "git",
                "-c",
                f"safe.directory={tmp_path.as_posix()}",
                "-c",
                "user.name=Performance Test",
                "-c",
                "user.email=performance-test@example.invalid",
                *args,
            ],
            cwd=tmp_path,
            text=True,
        ).strip()

    git("init", "-q")
    (tmp_path / "README.md").write_text("before\n")
    (tmp_path / "removed.txt").write_text("remove\n")
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-qm", "baseline")
    base = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    (tmp_path / "README.md").write_text("after\n")
    (tmp_path / "removed.txt").unlink()
    (tmp_path / "new.py").write_text("def operation():\n    return 1\n")
    assessment = tmp_path / ASSESSMENT
    assessment.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    assessment.write_text("{}")
    actual_base, changes = changed_inputs(tmp_path, base)
    assert actual_base == base
    assert set(changes) == {"README.md", "removed.txt", "new.py"}
    assert "operation" in object_value(object_value(changes["new.py"])["owners"])
    with pytest.raises(subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        changed_inputs(tmp_path, "f" * 40)

def _assessment(
    path: str,
    *,
    owner: str = "@document",
    category: str = "governance",
    operations: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    selected: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], dict[str, object], dict[str, object]]:
    mapping = read_object(ROOT / MAP)
    changes: dict[str, object] = {
        path: {
            "before_sha256": "a",
            "after_sha256": "b",
            "owners": {owner: {"before": "a", "after": "b"}},
        }
    }
    result: dict[str, object] = {
        "policy": POLICY,
        "base": BASE,
        "runtime_build_id": BUILD,
        "operation_map_sha256": canonical_digest(mapping),
        "changes": changes,
        "rows": {
            path: {
                "category": category,
                "operations": list(operations),
                "selected_families": list(selected),
                "rationale": "Explicit reviewed operation relevance for this exact changed owner.",
                "source_obligation": (
                    "Source-backed ordinary branch correction with unchanged algorithm."
                ),
                "unchanged_work": (
                    "The bounded branch preserves iteration, cache and reconstruction work."
                ),
            }
        },
        "milestone": "ordinary",
        "comparisons": {name: f"docs/performance/current/{name}.json" for name in selected},
        "full_game": None,
    }
    return result, changes, mapping


def _validate(
    value: dict[str, object],
    changes: dict[str, object],
    mapping: dict[str, object],
    *,
    base: str = BASE,
) -> set[str]:

def test_order108_smoke_scope_authenticates_complete_semantic_rows(path: str, drift: str) -> None:
    scope = read_object(ROOT / ORDER108_SCOPE)
    base = str(scope["base"])
    operation = "visibility-query" if "/core/" in path else "geometry-search"
    value, changes, mapping = _assessment(path, category="rule_semantics", operations=(operation,))
    change = copy.deepcopy(object_value(object_value(scope["changes"])[path]))
    changes[path] = change
    value["base"] = base
    rows = object_value(value["rows"])
    row = object_value(rows[path])
    owners = object_value(change["owners"])
    assert owners
    owner = next(iter(owners))
    if drift == "base":
        base = BASE
        value["base"] = base
    elif drift == "path":
        renamed = path.replace(".py", "_other.py")
        changes[renamed] = changes.pop(path)
        rows[renamed] = rows.pop(path)
    elif drift in {"before_file", "after_file"}:
        change[drift.removesuffix("_file") + "_sha256"] = "0" * 64
    elif drift in {"before_owner", "after_owner"}:
        object_value(owners[owner])[drift.removesuffix("_owner")] = "0" * 64
    elif drift == "extra_owner":
        owners["additional_operation"] = {"before": None, "after": "0" * 64}
    elif drift == "missing_owner":
        owners.pop(owner)
    elif drift == "category":
        row["category"] = "algorithm_or_search"
    if drift == "none":
        assert _validate(value, changes, mapping, base=base) == set()
    else:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Missing required detailed comparisons"):
            _validate(value, changes, mapping, base=base)

def test_diff_binding_includes_untracked_and_deleted_files_and_only_excludes_assessment(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    def git(*args: str) -> str:
        return subprocess.check_output(
            [
                "git",
                "-c",
                f"safe.directory={tmp_path.as_posix()}",
                "-c",
                "user.name=Performance Test",
                "-c",
                "user.email=performance-test@example.invalid",
                *args,
            ],
            cwd=tmp_path,
            text=True,
        ).strip()

    git("init", "-q")
    (tmp_path / "README.md").write_text("before\n")
    (tmp_path / "removed.txt").write_text("remove\n")
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-qm", "baseline")
    base = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    (tmp_path / "README.md").write_text("after\n")
    (tmp_path / "removed.txt").unlink()
    (tmp_path / "new.py").write_text("def operation():\n    return 1\n")

    actual_base, changes = changed_inputs(tmp_path, base)
    assert actual_base == base
    assert set(changes) == {"README.md", "removed.txt", "new.py"}
    assert "operation" in object_value(object_value(changes["new.py"])["owners"])
    with pytest.raises(subprocess.CalledProcessError):

class _DigestScope(Protocol):

class _PreflightMechanisms(Protocol):
    @property

    def _Digests(self, limit: int = ...) -> _DigestProbe: ...

        opened: os.stat_result,
        closed: os.stat_result,
        after: os.stat_result,

    ) -> bool: ...

    def digest_limit(self) -> int:
        return self._DIGEST_LIMIT

    def digest_scope(self) -> _DigestScope:
        return self._DIGESTS

    def digests(self, limit: int) -> _DigestProbe:
        return self._Digests(limit)

    def source_digest(self, path: str, raw: bytes) -> str:

        | {successor.SELF}

    )
    for name in owned:

    git_directory = (

        .decode()
        .strip()
    )

    monkeypatch.setattr(successor, "_git", original_git)

    assert _SuccessorMechanisms.freeze(successor_probe, tmp_path) == successor.FREEZE_COMMIT
    path = tmp_path / successor.INVENTORY

    changed = (json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    path.write_bytes(changed)

def test_pure_source_hash_memo_is_exact_bounded_and_validator_specific(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    assert _PreflightMechanisms.digest_limit(_preflight) == 512 * 1024 * 1024
    calls: list[str] = []
    sha = hashlib.sha256

    def first(raw: bytes) -> Any:
        calls.append("first")
        return sha(raw)

    def second(raw: bytes) -> Any:
        calls.append("second")
        return sha(raw)

    monkeypatch.setattr(preflight, "hashlib", SimpleNamespace(sha256=first))
    memo = _PreflightMechanisms.digests(_preflight, 8)
    assert memo.digest("a", b"1234") == sha(b"1234").hexdigest()
    assert memo.digest("a", b"1234") == sha(b"1234").hexdigest()
    assert calls == ["first"]
    assert memo.digest("b", b"1234") == sha(b"1234").hexdigest()
    assert len(calls) == 2
    assert memo.retained == 8
    assert memo.digest("a", b"5678") == sha(b"5678").hexdigest()
    assert len(calls) == 3
    assert memo.retained == 8
    assert memo.digest("overflow", b"more") == sha(b"more").hexdigest()
    assert len(memo.entries) == 2
    assert memo.retained == 8
    assert memo.digest("a", b"larger-than-cap") == sha(b"larger-than-cap").hexdigest()
    assert memo.retained == 4
    assert (first, "a") not in memo.entries
    monkeypatch.setattr(preflight, "hashlib", SimpleNamespace(sha256=second))
    assert memo.digest("b", b"1234") == sha(b"1234").hexdigest()
    assert calls[-1] == "second"
    assert memo.retained == 8
    assert sum(len(raw) for raw, _ in memo.entries.values()) == memo.retained <= memo.limit


def test_pure_source_hash_memo_resets_after_nested_exceptions_and_new_invocations() -> None:
    assert _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get() is None
    scopes: list[_DigestProbe] = []

    @preflight.invocation
    def outer() -> None:
        current = _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get()
        assert current is not None
        assert current.retained == 0
        scopes.append(current)
        _PreflightMechanisms.source_digest(_preflight, "a", b"original")
        assert current.retained == len(b"original")

        @preflight.invocation
        def inner() -> None:
            nested = _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get()
            assert nested is not None
            assert nested is not current
            assert nested.retained == 0
            _PreflightMechanisms.source_digest(_preflight, "a", b"changed")
            raise ValueError("nested failure")

        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="nested failure"):
            inner()
        assert _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get() is current
        assert current.retained == len(b"original")
        raise ValueError("outer failure")

    for _ in range(2):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="outer failure"):
            outer()
        assert _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get() is None
    assert scopes[0] is not scopes[1]
    assert all(scope.retained == 0 and not scope.entries for scope in scopes)

def test_frozen_blob_batch_rejects_changed_members_and_malformed_payloads(

    content = b"exact\0payload\n"
    size = str(len(content)).encode()
    oid = (
        hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + size + b"\0" + content, usedforsecurity=False).hexdigest().encode()
    )
    row = b"100644 blob " + oid + b"\ta.txt\0"
    batch = oid + b" blob " + size + b"\n" + content + b"\n"
    tree_changes = {
        "missing_member": b"",
        "extra_member": row + row.replace(b"a.txt", b"extra.txt"),
        "duplicate_member": row + row,
        "nonregular": row.replace(b"100644", b"120000"),
        "tree_type": row.replace(b"blob", b"tree"),

        "tree_framing": row[:-1],
    }
    blob_changes = {
        "missing_blob": oid + b" missing\n",
        "blob_oid": batch.replace(oid, b"0" * 40, 1),
        "blob_type": batch.replace(b" blob ", b" tree ", 1),
        "negative_size": batch.replace(b" blob " + size, b" blob -1", 1),
        "noncanonical_size": batch.replace(b" blob " + size, b" blob 0" + size, 1),
        "truncated": batch[:-2],
        "separator": batch[:-1] + b"x",
        "trailing": batch + b"unrequested\n",
        "content": batch.replace(b"exact", b"other", 1),

@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["nonzero", "surplus", "truncated", "hash", "type", "size"])
def test_history_closed_protocol_rejects_synthetic_malformed_native_response(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, kind: str
) -> None:
    from tools import performance_history_snapshot

    history = cast(_HistoryMechanisms, performance_history_snapshot)
    root, revision, contents = _history_fixture(tmp_path, packed=False)
    original = _HistoryMechanisms.closed(history)
    positive = _HistoryMechanisms.builder(history, root)
    assert positive.add("plain60", revision, {"a": None}, "positive") == {"a": contents["a"]}

    def corrupt(root: Path, domain: Domain, args: tuple[str, ...], **kwargs: Any) -> bytes:
        raw = original(root, domain, args, **kwargs)
        if args != ("cat-file", "--batch"):
            return raw
        if kind == "nonzero":
            raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(3, args, raw)
        if kind == "surplus":
            return raw + b"extra"
        if kind == "truncated":
            return raw[:-1]
        if kind == "hash":
            split = raw.index(b"\n") + 1
            return raw[:split] + bytes([raw[split] ^ 1]) + raw[split + 1 :]
        if kind == "type":
            return raw.replace(b" commit ", b" blob ", 1)
        return raw.replace(b" commit ", b" commit 0", 1)

    monkeypatch.setattr(history, "_closed", corrupt)
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, subprocess.CalledProcessError)):
        _HistoryMechanisms.builder(history, root).add("plain60", revision, {"a": None}, "negative")
    monkeypatch.setattr(history, "_closed", original)
    assert _HistoryMechanisms.builder(history, root).add(
        "plain60", revision, {"a": None}, "restored"
    ) == {"a": contents["a"]}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["nonzero", "timeout", "overflow", "cancellation", "blocked_pipe"])
def test_history_closed_process_requires_eof_zero_exit_and_reaps_child(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, mode: str
) -> None:
    import sys

    from tools import performance_history_snapshot

    history = cast(_HistoryMechanisms, performance_history_snapshot)
    children: list[subprocess.Popen[bytes]] = []
    original_popen = subprocess.Popen
    original_read = os.read

    def tracked(
        command: list[str],
        *,
        cwd: Path,
        stdin: int,
        stdout: int,
        stderr: int,
        start_new_session: bool,
    ) -> subprocess.Popen[bytes]:
        child = original_popen(
            command,
            cwd=cwd,
            stdin=stdin,
            stdout=stdout,
            stderr=stderr,
            start_new_session=start_new_session,
        )
        children.append(child)
        if mode == "cancellation":
            monkeypatch.setattr(os, "read", cancelled)
        return child

    program = {
        "nonzero": "import sys; print('complete'); sys.exit(7)",
        "timeout": "import time; print('complete', flush=True); time.sleep(10)",
        "overflow": "import sys; sys.stdout.write('x'*100000)",
        "cancellation": "import time; time.sleep(10)",
        "blocked_pipe": (
            "import subprocess,sys; "
            "subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', 'import time;time.sleep(10)']); "
            "print('complete',flush=True)"
        ),
    }[mode]

    def command(*_: object) -> list[str]:
        return [sys.executable, "-B", "-c", program]

    monkeypatch.setattr(history, "_argv", command)
    monkeypatch.setattr(subprocess, "Popen", tracked)
    monkeypatch.setattr(history, "_LIMITS", {"plain60": 0.2})

    def cancelled(descriptor: int, count: int) -> bytes:
        raise KeyboardInterrupt("synthetic cancellation")

    error = {
        "nonzero": subprocess.CalledProcessError,
        "timeout": subprocess.TimeoutExpired,
        "overflow": ValueError,
        "cancellation": KeyboardInterrupt,
        "blocked_pipe": subprocess.TimeoutExpired,
    }[mode]
    with pytest.raises(error):
        _HistoryMechanisms.closed(history)(tmp_path, "plain60", ("synthetic",), limit=16)
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "read", original_read)
    assert len(children) == 1
    assert children[0].poll() is not None
    assert children[0].stdin is not None
    assert children[0].stdin.closed
    assert children[0].stdout is not None
    assert children[0].stdout.closed
    assert children[0].stderr is not None
    assert children[0].stderr.closed

    import contextvars

    builder.members.clear()
    with _HistoryMechanisms.activate(history, first):
        assert first.blobs(root, "plain60", revision, ["a"]) == {"a": contents["a"]}
        copied = contextvars.copy_context()
        view = first.blobs(root, "plain60", revision, ["a"])
        view["a"] = b"caller mutation"
        assert first.blobs(root, "plain60", revision, ["a"]) == {"a": contents["a"]}
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            # Deliberately cross the immutable mapping boundary for this rejection control.
            cast(MutableMapping[tuple[Domain, str, str], bytes], first.contents)[
                "plain60", revision, "a"

                first.blobs(selected_root, cast(Domain, domain), commit, names)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Nested"), _HistoryMechanisms.activate(history, first):
            raise AssertionError("Nested phase must never publish.")
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
            future = executor.submit(first.blobs, root, "plain60", revision, ["a"])
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="owner"):
                future.result()

    assert performance_history_snapshot.eligible_blobs(root, revision, ["a"]) is None

    second_builder = _HistoryMechanisms.builder(history, root)

    assert first.phase_id != second.phase_id
    with _HistoryMechanisms.activate(history, second):
        assert second.blobs(root, "plain60", revision, ["a"]) == {"a": contents["a"]}
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="inactive"):

    third = _HistoryMechanisms.seal(
        history, second_builder, {"root": str(root)}, "fixture-runtime", "phase-three"

    attempt = tmp_path / "attempt.json"
    binding: dict[str, object] = {"input_digest": "positive-current-inputs"}

    def validate(root: Path, base_ref: str, *, pr_head: str | None) -> dict[str, object]:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        records = _HistoryMechanisms.records(history)
        assert records is not None
        records.append({"role": "preflight" if calls == 1 else "postflight"})
        if calls == 2:
            if failure == "timeout":
                raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(["git", "cat-file"], 60)
            if failure == "cancellation":
                raise KeyboardInterrupt
            raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(2, ["git", "cat-file"])
        return dict(binding)

    def smoke(root: Path, path: Path, *, binding: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
        report = binding | {"status": "passed", "attempt_receipt": str(attempt)}

        return report

    error = {
        "timeout": subprocess.TimeoutExpired,
        "nonzero": subprocess.CalledProcessError,
        "cancellation": KeyboardInterrupt,
    }[failure]
    with pytest.raises(error):
        _GateMechanisms.check_and_run(_gate, "exact-base", None, output)
    receipt = json.loads(output.read_text())
    assert receipt == json.loads(attempt.read_text())
    assert receipt["status"] == "failed"

    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:

    from tools import performance_history_snapshot as history

    class CumulativeTransport(Protocol):
        def _git(
            self,
            root: Path,
            *args: str,
            payload: bytes | None = None,
            historical: bool = False,
        ) -> bytes: ...

        def git(
            self,
            root: Path,
            *args: str,
            payload: bytes | None = None,
            historical: bool = False,
        ) -> bytes:
            return self._git(root, *args, payload=payload, historical=historical)

    transport = cast(CumulativeTransport, cumulative)
    commands: list[tuple[list[str], dict[str, Any]]] = []
    selected: list[tuple[Path, str, tuple[str, ...]]] = []

    def execute(command: list[str], **kwargs: Any) -> bytes:
        commands.append((command, kwargs))
        return b"native bytes"

    def historical(
        root: Path, domain: str, args: tuple[str, ...], fresh: Callable[[], bytes]
    ) -> bytes:
        selected.append((root, domain, args))
        return fresh()

    monkeypatch.setattr(subprocess, "check_output", execute)
    monkeypatch.setattr(history, "historical", historical)
    assert (
        CumulativeTransport.git(transport, tmp_path, "ls-files", payload=b"input")
        == b"native bytes"
    )
    assert commands == [
        (
            ["git", "-c", f"safe.directory={tmp_path.as_posix()}", "ls-files"],
            {"cwd": tmp_path, "input": b"input", "timeout": 60},
        )
    ]
    assert selected == []
    args = ("show", "a" * 40 + ":control.py")
    assert CumulativeTransport.git(transport, tmp_path, *args, historical=True) == b"native bytes"
    assert selected == [(tmp_path, "safe60", args)]
    assert commands[-1] == (
        ["git", "-c", f"safe.directory={tmp_path.as_posix()}", *args],
        {"cwd": tmp_path, "input": None, "timeout": 60},
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not accept a mutable payload"):
        CumulativeTransport.git(transport, tmp_path, *args, payload=b"input", historical=True)
    assert len(commands) == 2
    assert len(selected) == 1


class _HistoryBuilder(Protocol):
    objects: dict[tuple[Domain, str], tuple[str, bytes]]
    roots: dict[tuple[Domain, str], str]
    members: dict[tuple[Domain, str, str], Member]
    contents: dict[tuple[Domain, str, str], bytes]

    def add(
        self, domain: Domain, revision: str, pins: Mapping[str, str | None], authority: str
    ) -> dict[str, bytes]: ...
    def all_paths(self, domain: Domain, revision: str) -> set[str]: ...
    def finish(self) -> None: ...


class _ClosedHistory(Protocol):
    def __call__(
        self, root: Path, domain: Domain, args: tuple[str, ...], *, limit: int, payload: bytes = b""
    ) -> bytes: ...


class _HistoryIdentity(Protocol):
    def __call__(
        self, root: Path, base_ref: str, pr_head: str | None, *, domain_state: bool
    ) -> dict[str, object]: ...


class _HistoryMechanisms(Protocol):
    _Builder: Callable[[Path], _HistoryBuilder]
    _closed: _ClosedHistory
    _seal: Callable[[_HistoryBuilder, dict[str, object], str, str], Snapshot]
    _activate: Callable[[Snapshot], AbstractContextManager[Snapshot]]
    _identity: _HistoryIdentity
    _WITNESSES: ContextVar[list[dict[str, object]] | None]

    def builder(self, root: Path) -> _HistoryBuilder:
        return self._Builder(root)

    def closed(self) -> _ClosedHistory:
        return self._closed

    def seal(
        self, builder: _HistoryBuilder, identity: dict[str, object], runtime: str, phase_id: str
    ) -> Snapshot:
        return self._seal(builder, identity, runtime, phase_id)

    def activate(self, snapshot: Snapshot) -> AbstractContextManager[Snapshot]:
        return self._activate(snapshot)

    def identity(
        self, root: Path, base_ref: str, pr_head: str | None, *, domain_state: bool
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        return self._identity(root, base_ref, pr_head, domain_state=domain_state)

    def records(self) -> list[dict[str, object]] | None:
        return self._WITNESSES.get()


class _LeaseState(Protocol):
    def valid(self) -> bool: ...


class _LeasedSnapshot(Protocol):
    _lease: _LeaseState

    def valid(self) -> bool:
        return self._lease.valid()


class _ReceiptWriter(Protocol):
    def _write_receipt(self, output: Path, report: dict[str, object]) -> None: ...
    def write(self, output: Path, report: dict[str, object]) -> None:
        self._write_receipt(output, report)

class _DigestProbe(Protocol):
    @property
    def limit(self) -> int: ...

    @property
    def retained(self) -> int: ...

    @property
    def entries(self) -> Mapping[tuple[Callable[..., Any], str], tuple[bytes, str]]: ...

    def digest(self, path: str, raw: bytes) -> str: ...


class _DigestScope(Protocol):
    def get(self) -> _DigestProbe | None: ...


class _PreflightMechanisms(Protocol):
    @property
    def _DIGEST_LIMIT(self) -> int: ...

    @property
    def _DIGESTS(self) -> _DigestScope: ...

    def _Digests(self, limit: int = ...) -> _DigestProbe: ...

    def _source_digest(self, path: str, raw: bytes) -> str: ...

    def _same_read(
        self,
        before: os.stat_result,
        opened: os.stat_result,
        closed: os.stat_result,
        after: os.stat_result,
        *,
        windows: bool,
    ) -> bool: ...

    def digest_limit(self) -> int:
        return self._DIGEST_LIMIT

    def digest_scope(self) -> _DigestScope:
        return self._DIGESTS

    def digests(self, limit: int) -> _DigestProbe:
        return self._Digests(limit)

    def source_digest(self, path: str, raw: bytes) -> str:
        return self._source_digest(path, raw)

    def same_read(
        self,
        before: os.stat_result,
        opened: os.stat_result,
        closed: os.stat_result,
        after: os.stat_result,
        *,
        windows: bool,
    ) -> bool:
        return self._same_read(before, opened, closed, after, windows=windows)


class _GateMechanisms(Protocol):
    def _check_and_run(
        self, base_ref: str, pr_head: str | None, output: Path
    ) -> dict[str, object]: ...

    def check_and_run(self, base_ref: str, pr_head: str | None, output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
        return self._check_and_run(base_ref, pr_head, output)


class _PolicyMechanisms(Protocol):

class _GitCommand(Protocol):

class _SuccessorMechanisms(Protocol):
    def _git(self, root: Path, *args: str, payload: bytes | None = None) -> bytes: ...

    def _freeze(self, root: Path) -> str: ...

    def _blobs(self, root: Path, revision: str, names: list[str]) -> dict[str, bytes]: ...

    def git(self, root: Path, *args: str, payload: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
        return self._git(root, *args, payload=payload)

    def freeze(self, root: Path) -> str:

    def blobs(self, root: Path, revision: str, names: list[str]) -> dict[str, bytes]:

def test_recipe_cache_is_local_exact_and_validator_specific() -> None:
    calls: list[str] = []

    @preflight.recipe_proof
    def first(before: bytes, current: bytes, recipe: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        calls.append("first")
        if before != current or recipe != {"edits": []}:
            raise ValueError("changed proof")

    @preflight.recipe_proof
    def second(before: bytes, current: bytes, recipe: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        calls.append("second")
        raise ValueError("independent validator")

    @preflight.invocation
    def validate() -> None:
        first(b"source", b"source", {"edits": []})
        first(b"source", b"source", {"edits": []})
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="changed proof"):
            first(b"source", b"changed", {"edits": []})
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="changed proof"):
            first(b"source", b"source", {"edits": [1]})
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="independent validator"):
            second(b"source", b"source", {"edits": []})

    validate()
    validate()
    assert calls == ["first", "first", "first", "second"] * 2
    first(b"source", b"source", {"edits": []})
    first(b"source", b"source", {"edits": []})
    assert calls[-2:] == ["first", "first"]

@pytest.mark.parametrize("same_bytes", [False, True])
def test_owned_windows_scan_rejects_write_at_final_path_query(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, same_bytes: bool
) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "source.py"
    original = b"before"
    path.write_bytes(original)
    metadata = path.stat()
    observations: list[os.stat_result] = []
    reader_fd: int | None = None
    mutated = False
    final_path_observed = False
    final_handle_observed = False

    def observe_handle(fd: int) -> os.stat_result:
        nonlocal reader_fd, final_handle_observed
        reader_fd = fd
        result = os.fstat(fd)
        observations.append(result)
        if final_path_observed:
            final_handle_observed = True
        return result

    def observe_path(name: str) -> os.stat_result:
        nonlocal mutated, final_path_observed
        if name == path.as_posix() and len(observations) == 2:
            assert reader_fd is not None
            # The reader must remain open across this real final-query write.
            assert os.fstat(reader_fd) == observations[-1]
            path.write_bytes(original if same_bytes else b"edited")
            os.utime(path, ns=(metadata.st_atime_ns, metadata.st_mtime_ns))
            assert os.fstat(reader_fd).st_ctime_ns != observations[-1].st_ctime_ns
            mutated = True
            final_path_observed = True
        return os.lstat(name)

    # Select the Windows path without changing os.name used by pathlib/pytest.
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        preflight,
        "os",
        SimpleNamespace(name="nt", path=os.path, lstat=observe_path, fstat=observe_handle),
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="changed during owned read"):
        preflight.source_hashes(tmp_path, {path.name})
    assert mutated
    assert final_handle_observed
    assert len(observations) == 3
    assert path.stat().st_mtime_ns == metadata.st_mtime_ns
    assert path.read_bytes() == (original if same_bytes else b"edited")


def _read_metadata(*, ctime: int, changed: str = "") -> os.stat_result:
    fields = {"mode": 0o100644, "ino": 2, "dev": 3, "nlink": 1, "size": 6, "mtime": 5}
    if changed:
        fields[changed] += 1
    return os.stat_result(
        (
            fields["mode"],
            fields["ino"],
            fields["dev"],
            fields["nlink"],
            0,
            0,
            fields["size"],
            0,
            0,
            0,
        ),
        {"st_mtime_ns": fields["mtime"], "st_ctime_ns": ctime},
    )

) -> None:

def test_pure_source_hash_memo_is_exact_bounded_and_validator_specific(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    assert _PreflightMechanisms.digest_limit(_preflight) == 512 * 1024 * 1024
    calls: list[str] = []
    sha = hashlib.sha256

    def first(raw: bytes) -> Any:
        calls.append("first")
        return sha(raw)

    def second(raw: bytes) -> Any:
        calls.append("second")
        return sha(raw)

    monkeypatch.setattr(preflight, "hashlib", SimpleNamespace(sha256=first))
    memo = _PreflightMechanisms.digests(_preflight, 8)
    assert memo.digest("a", b"1234") == sha(b"1234").hexdigest()
    assert memo.digest("a", b"1234") == sha(b"1234").hexdigest()
    assert calls == ["first"]
    assert memo.digest("b", b"1234") == sha(b"1234").hexdigest()
    assert len(calls) == 2
    assert memo.retained == 8
    assert memo.digest("a", b"5678") == sha(b"5678").hexdigest()
    assert len(calls) == 3
    assert memo.retained == 8
    assert memo.digest("overflow", b"more") == sha(b"more").hexdigest()
    assert len(memo.entries) == 2
    assert memo.retained == 8
    assert memo.digest("a", b"larger-than-cap") == sha(b"larger-than-cap").hexdigest()
    assert memo.retained == 4
    assert (first, "a") not in memo.entries
    monkeypatch.setattr(preflight, "hashlib", SimpleNamespace(sha256=second))
    assert memo.digest("b", b"1234") == sha(b"1234").hexdigest()
    assert calls[-1] == "second"
    assert memo.retained == 8
    assert sum(len(raw) for raw, _ in memo.entries.values()) == memo.retained <= memo.limit


def test_pure_source_hash_memo_resets_after_nested_exceptions_and_new_invocations() -> None:
    assert _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get() is None
    scopes: list[_DigestProbe] = []

    @preflight.invocation
    def outer() -> None:
        current = _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get()
        assert current is not None
        assert current.retained == 0
        scopes.append(current)
        _PreflightMechanisms.source_digest(_preflight, "a", b"original")
        assert current.retained == len(b"original")

        @preflight.invocation
        def inner() -> None:
            nested = _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get()
            assert nested is not None
            assert nested is not current
            assert nested.retained == 0
            _PreflightMechanisms.source_digest(_preflight, "a", b"changed")
            raise ValueError("nested failure")

        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="nested failure"):
            inner()
        assert _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get() is current
        assert current.retained == len(b"original")
        raise ValueError("outer failure")

    for _ in range(2):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="outer failure"):
            outer()
        assert _PreflightMechanisms.digest_scope(_preflight).get() is None
    assert scopes[0] is not scopes[1]
    assert all(scope.retained == 0 and not scope.entries for scope in scopes)

    oid = (
        hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + size + b"\0" + content, usedforsecurity=False).hexdigest().encode()
    )
    row = b"100644 blob " + oid + b"\ta.txt\0"

@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["nonzero", "surplus", "truncated", "hash", "type", "size"])
def test_history_closed_protocol_rejects_synthetic_malformed_native_response(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, kind: str
) -> None:

    def corrupt(root: Path, domain: Domain, args: tuple[str, ...], **kwargs: Any) -> bytes:

        return raw.replace(b" commit ", b" commit 0", 1)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["nonzero", "timeout", "overflow", "cancellation", "blocked_pipe"])
def test_history_closed_process_requires_eof_zero_exit_and_reaps_child(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, mode: str
) -> None:
    import sys

    from tools import performance_history_snapshot

    history = cast(_HistoryMechanisms, performance_history_snapshot)
    children: list[subprocess.Popen[bytes]] = []
    original_popen = subprocess.Popen
    original_read = os.read

    def tracked(
        command: list[str],
        *,
        cwd: Path,
        stdin: int,
        stdout: int,
        stderr: int,
        start_new_session: bool,
    ) -> subprocess.Popen[bytes]:
        child = original_popen(
            command,
            cwd=cwd,
            stdin=stdin,
            stdout=stdout,
            stderr=stderr,
            start_new_session=start_new_session,
        )
        children.append(child)
        if mode == "cancellation":
            monkeypatch.setattr(os, "read", cancelled)
        return child

    program = {
        "nonzero": "import sys; print('complete'); sys.exit(7)",
        "timeout": "import time; print('complete', flush=True); time.sleep(10)",
        "overflow": "import sys; sys.stdout.write('x'*100000)",
        "cancellation": "import time; time.sleep(10)",
        "blocked_pipe": (
            "import subprocess,sys; "
            "subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', 'import time;time.sleep(10)']); "
            "print('complete',flush=True)"
        ),
    }[mode]

    def command(*_: object) -> list[str]:
        return [sys.executable, "-B", "-c", program]

    monkeypatch.setattr(history, "_argv", command)
    monkeypatch.setattr(subprocess, "Popen", tracked)
    monkeypatch.setattr(history, "_LIMITS", {"plain60": 0.2})

    def cancelled(descriptor: int, count: int) -> bytes:
        raise KeyboardInterrupt("synthetic cancellation")

    error = {
        "nonzero": subprocess.CalledProcessError,
        "timeout": subprocess.TimeoutExpired,
        "overflow": ValueError,
        "cancellation": KeyboardInterrupt,
        "blocked_pipe": subprocess.TimeoutExpired,
    }[mode]
    with pytest.raises(error):
        _HistoryMechanisms.closed(history)(tmp_path, "plain60", ("synthetic",), limit=16)
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "read", original_read)
    assert len(children) == 1
    assert children[0].poll() is not None
    assert children[0].stdin is not None
    assert children[0].stdin.closed
    assert children[0].stdout is not None
    assert children[0].stdout.closed
    assert children[0].stderr is not None
    assert children[0].stderr.closed

@pytest.mark.parametrize("packed", [False, True])
def test_history_phase_owns_immutable_bytes_revokes_copied_context_and_reacquires(
    tmp_path: Path, packed: bool
) -> None:
    import contextvars
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

    from tools import performance_history_snapshot

    history = cast(_HistoryMechanisms, performance_history_snapshot)
    root, revision, contents = _history_fixture(tmp_path, packed=packed)
    builder = _HistoryMechanisms.builder(history, root)
    assert builder.add("plain60", revision, {"a": None}, "native-authority") == {"a": contents["a"]}
    builder.finish()
    first = _HistoryMechanisms.seal(
        history, builder, {"root": str(root)}, "fixture-runtime", "phase-one"
    )
    original_certificate = first.certificate
    builder.contents.clear()
    builder.members.clear()
    with _HistoryMechanisms.activate(history, first):
        assert first.blobs(root, "plain60", revision, ["a"]) == {"a": contents["a"]}
        copied = contextvars.copy_context()
        view = first.blobs(root, "plain60", revision, ["a"])
        view["a"] = b"caller mutation"
        assert first.blobs(root, "plain60", revision, ["a"]) == {"a": contents["a"]}
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            # Deliberately cross the immutable mapping boundary for this rejection control.
            cast(MutableMapping[tuple[Domain, str, str], bytes], first.contents)[
                "plain60", revision, "a"
            ] = b"mutation"
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            vars(first)
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            vars(first.members["plain60", revision, "a"])
        for domain, commit, names, selected_root in (
            ("safe60", revision, ["a"], root),
            ("plain60", "0" * 40, ["a"], root),
            ("plain60", revision, ["empty"], root),
            ("plain60", revision, ["a", "a"], root),
            ("plain60", revision, ["a"], tmp_path),
        ):
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"History|history"):
                first.blobs(selected_root, cast(Domain, domain), commit, names)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Nested"), _HistoryMechanisms.activate(history, first):
            raise AssertionError("Nested phase must never publish.")
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
            future = executor.submit(first.blobs, root, "plain60", revision, ["a"])
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="owner"):
                future.result()
        assert first.certificate == original_certificate
    assert performance_history_snapshot.eligible_blobs(root, revision, ["a"]) is None
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="inactive"):
        first.blobs(root, "plain60", revision, ["a"])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="inactive"):
        copied.run(first.blobs, root, "plain60", revision, ["a"])
    second_builder = _HistoryMechanisms.builder(history, root)
    second_builder.add("plain60", revision, {"a": None}, "native-authority")
    second_builder.finish()
    second = _HistoryMechanisms.seal(
        history, second_builder, {"root": str(root)}, "fixture-runtime", "phase-two"
    )
    assert first.semantic_digest == second.semantic_digest
    assert first.phase_id != second.phase_id
    with _HistoryMechanisms.activate(history, second):
        assert second.blobs(root, "plain60", revision, ["a"]) == {"a": contents["a"]}
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="inactive"):
            copied.run(first.blobs, root, "plain60", revision, ["a"])
    third = _HistoryMechanisms.seal(
        history, second_builder, {"root": str(root)}, "fixture-runtime", "phase-three"
    )
    with (
        pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="body failure"),
        _HistoryMechanisms.activate(history, third),
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("body failure")
    assert performance_history_snapshot.eligible_blobs(root, revision, ["a"]) is None
    assert _LeasedSnapshot.valid(cast(_LeasedSnapshot, third)) is False

class _HistoryBuilder(Protocol):
    objects: dict[tuple[Domain, str], tuple[str, bytes]]
    roots: dict[tuple[Domain, str], str]
    members: dict[tuple[Domain, str, str], Member]
    contents: dict[tuple[Domain, str, str], bytes]

    def add(
        self, domain: Domain, revision: str, pins: Mapping[str, str | None], authority: str
    ) -> dict[str, bytes]: ...
    def all_paths(self, domain: Domain, revision: str) -> set[str]: ...
    def finish(self) -> None: ...


class _ClosedHistory(Protocol):
    def __call__(
        self, root: Path, domain: Domain, args: tuple[str, ...], *, limit: int, payload: bytes = b""
    ) -> bytes: ...


class _HistoryIdentity(Protocol):
    def __call__(
        self, root: Path, base_ref: str, pr_head: str | None, *, domain_state: bool
    ) -> dict[str, object]: ...


class _HistoryMechanisms(Protocol):
    _Builder: Callable[[Path], _HistoryBuilder]
    _closed: _ClosedHistory
    _seal: Callable[[_HistoryBuilder, dict[str, object], str, str], Snapshot]
    _activate: Callable[[Snapshot], AbstractContextManager[Snapshot]]
    _identity: _HistoryIdentity
    _WITNESSES: ContextVar[list[dict[str, object]] | None]

    def builder(self, root: Path) -> _HistoryBuilder:
        return self._Builder(root)

    def closed(self) -> _ClosedHistory:
        return self._closed

    def seal(
        self, builder: _HistoryBuilder, identity: dict[str, object], runtime: str, phase_id: str
    ) -> Snapshot:
        return self._seal(builder, identity, runtime, phase_id)

    def activate(self, snapshot: Snapshot) -> AbstractContextManager[Snapshot]:
        return self._activate(snapshot)

    def identity(
        self, root: Path, base_ref: str, pr_head: str | None, *, domain_state: bool
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        return self._identity(root, base_ref, pr_head, domain_state=domain_state)

    def records(self) -> list[dict[str, object]] | None:
        return self._WITNESSES.get()


class _LeaseState(Protocol):
    def valid(self) -> bool: ...


class _LeasedSnapshot(Protocol):
    _lease: _LeaseState

    def valid(self) -> bool:
        return self._lease.valid()


class _ReceiptWriter(Protocol):
    def _write_receipt(self, output: Path, report: dict[str, object]) -> None: ...
    def write(self, output: Path, report: dict[str, object]) -> None:
        self._write_receipt(output, report)

def test_ci66_path_plan_charge_and_full_budget_fallback(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    import sys

    for index in range(12):
        (tmp_path / str(index)).write_bytes(b"owned")

    @preflight.invocation
    def run() -> None:
        storage = _ci66_storage()
        for index in range(11):
            preflight.source_members(tmp_path, [str(index)])
        plans = storage.path_plans
        assert plans is not None
        assert len(plans) == 11
        charge = sys.getsizeof(plans)
        for key, plan in plans.items():
            assert all(type(value) is str for value in (*plan[0], plan[1]))
            charge += (
                sys.getsizeof(key)
                + sys.getsizeof(key[1])
                + sys.getsizeof(key[2])
                + sys.getsizeof(key[3])
                + sys.getsizeof(plan)
                + sys.getsizeof(plan[0])
                + sum(sys.getsizeof(value) for value in plan[0])
                + sys.getsizeof(plan[1])
            )
        assert storage.path_plan_charge == storage.retained == charge
        storage.limit = charge
        assert preflight.source_members(tmp_path, ["11"])[0][2] == b"owned"
        assert storage.path_plans is plans
        assert storage.retained == storage.path_plan_charge == charge
        assert len(plans) == 11
        assert preflight.source_members(tmp_path, ["0"])[0][2] == b"owned"
        assert storage.retained == charge

    run()

class _Ci60Mechanisms(Protocol):
    def _current_applicability(
        self, actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str], family: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]: ...

    def applicability(
        self, actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str], family: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._current_applicability(actual, current, family)

    def validators(self) -> tuple[AdmissionValidator, AdmissionValidator]:
        return self._admitted_derivation, self._derivation_transition

    def _derivation_transition(
        self, operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]
    ) -> None: ...

    def transition(self, operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        return self._derivation_transition(operands, identity)

    def _admitted_derivation(
        self, operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]
    ) -> None: ...

    def derive(self, operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        return self._admitted_derivation(operands, identity)

def test_activated_native_history_revokes_copied_phase_after_completion(
    cancel: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

    from tools import performance_ci60_qualification as ci60
    from tools import performance_history_snapshot as history

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    copied: list[contextvars.Context] = []
    observations: list[tuple[str, ...]] = []
    source_members = preflight.source_members
    computations: list[str] = []
    original, transition = _Ci60Mechanisms.validators(cast(_Ci60Mechanisms, ci60))

    def original_proof(operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        computations.append("original")
        original(operands, identity)

    def transition_proof(operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        computations.append("transition")
        transition(operands, identity)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ci60, "_admitted_derivation", original_proof)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ci60, "_derivation_transition", transition_proof)

    def observe(selected: Path, names: list[str]) -> AdmissionOperands:
        result = source_members(selected, names)
        observations.append(tuple(names))
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(preflight, "source_members", observe)

    @preflight.invocation
    def run() -> None:
        with history.phase(root, ci60.PR_BASE, None):
            computations.clear()  # Acquisition performs its own unscoped admission.
            identity = history.proof_identity(root)
            assert identity is not None
            assert identity[0] == root.as_posix()
            assert len(identity[1]) == 32
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="another repository"):
                history.proof_identity(root / "different")
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
                wrong_thread = contextvars.copy_context()
                with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="inactive"):
                    pool.submit(wrong_thread.run, history.proof_identity, root).result(timeout=5)
            start = len(observations)
            first = ci60.admitted(root)
            first_observations = observations[start:]
            first[ci60.SELF] = b"caller-owned dictionary"
            start = len(observations)
            second = ci60.admitted(root)
            assert observations[start:] == first_observations
            assert computations == ["transition", "original"]
            original_names = (
                ci60.history(root, "diff", "--name-only", ci60.BASE, str(ci60.FREEZE))
                .decode()
                .splitlines()
            )
            assert first_observations[:3] == [
                (ci60.ASSESSMENT,),
                (ci60.ASSESSMENT,),
                tuple(original_names),
            ]
            assert sum(map(len, first_observations[:3])) == 109
            assert set(first_observations[3]) == ci60.DERIVATION_MEMBERS
            assert len(first_observations) == 4
            assert second[ci60.SELF] == (root / ci60.SELF).read_bytes()
            copied.append(contextvars.copy_context())
            if cancel:
                raise KeyboardInterrupt("phase cancelled")

    if cancel:
        with pytest.raises(KeyboardInterrupt, match="phase cancelled"):
            run()
    else:
        run()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="inactive"):
        copied[0].run(history.proof_identity, root)

class _Storage(Protocol):
    limit: int
    retained: int
    active: bool
    admissions: dict[tuple[Any, ...], AdmissionOperands]

    def digest(self, path: str, raw: bytes) -> str: ...

    def admission(
        self,

        identity: tuple[str, ...],
        dependencies: tuple[Callable[..., Any], ...],
    ) -> None: ...


class _Mechanisms(Protocol):

    def _same_read(
        self,
        before: os.stat_result,
        opened: os.stat_result,
        closed: os.stat_result,
        after: os.stat_result,
        *,
        windows: bool,
    ) -> bool: ...

    def storage(self, limit: int) -> _Storage:
        return self._Digests(limit)

    def read_validator(self) -> Callable[..., bool]:
        return self._same_read

IDENTITY: tuple[str, ...] = ("repository", "phase", "native-catalog", "plain60")

class _Ci60Mechanisms(Protocol):
    def _current_applicability(
        self, actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str], family: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]: ...

    def applicability(
        self, actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str], family: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._current_applicability(actual, current, family)

    def validators(self) -> tuple[AdmissionValidator, AdmissionValidator]:
        return self._admitted_derivation, self._derivation_transition

    def _derivation_transition(
        self, operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]
    ) -> None: ...

    def transition(self, operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        return self._derivation_transition(operands, identity)

    def _admitted_derivation(
        self, operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]
    ) -> None: ...

    def derive(self, operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        return self._admitted_derivation(operands, identity)

def test_activated_native_history_revokes_copied_phase_after_completion(
    cancel: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

    from tools import performance_ci60_qualification as ci60
    from tools import performance_history_snapshot as history

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    copied: list[contextvars.Context] = []

    source_members = preflight.source_members
    computations: list[str] = []
    original, transition = _Ci60Mechanisms.validators(cast(_Ci60Mechanisms, ci60))

    def original_proof(operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        computations.append("original")
        original(operands, identity)

    def transition_proof(operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        computations.append("transition")
        transition(operands, identity)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ci60, "_admitted_derivation", original_proof)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ci60, "_derivation_transition", transition_proof)

    def observe(selected: Path, names: list[str]) -> AdmissionOperands:
        result = source_members(selected, names)
        observations.append(tuple(names))
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(preflight, "source_members", observe)
    live_head_checks: list[tuple[str, ...]] = []
    original_git = ci60.git

    def observe_git(selected: Path, *args: str) -> bytes:
        if args[:2] == ("merge-base", "--is-ancestor") and args[-1] == "HEAD":
            live_head_checks.append(args)
        return original_git(selected, *args)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ci60, "git", observe_git)

    @preflight.invocation
    def run() -> None:
        computations.clear()  # Include the original bootstrap computation.
        with history.phase(root, ci60.PR_BASE, None):
            assert computations == ["transition", "original"]
            identity = history.proof_identity(root)
            assert identity is not None
            assert identity[0] == root.as_posix()
            assert len(identity[1]) == 32
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="another repository"):
                history.proof_identity(root / "different")
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
                wrong_thread = contextvars.copy_context()
                with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="inactive"):
                    pool.submit(wrong_thread.run, history.proof_identity, root).result(timeout=5)
            start = len(observations)
            head_start = len(live_head_checks)
            first = ci60.admitted(root)
            first_observations = observations[start:]
            first_head_checks = live_head_checks[head_start:]
            assert first_head_checks == [
                ("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", str(freeze), "HEAD")
                for freeze in (ci60.FREEZE, ci60.DERIVATION_FREEZE, ci60.PRELUDE_FREEZE)
            ]
            first[ci60.SELF] = b"caller-owned dictionary"
            start = len(observations)
            head_start = len(live_head_checks)
            second = ci60.admitted(root)
            assert live_head_checks[head_start:] == first_head_checks
            assert observations[start:] == first_observations
            assert computations == ["transition", "original"]
            latest_names = (
                ci60.history(
                    root, "diff", "--name-only", ci60.PRELUDE_BASE, str(ci60.PRELUDE_FREEZE)
                )
                .decode()
                .splitlines()
            )
            extra_observed = {
                "tests/code_quality/test_performance_category_migration.py",
                "tools/performance_preflight_successor.py",
            }
            assert len(extra_observed) == 2
            assert len(first_observations) == 5
            assert len(first_observations[4]) == 22
            assert sum(map(len, first_observations)) == 158
            assert first_observations[4] == tuple(
                name for name in latest_names if name in ci60.PRELUDE_OBSERVED
            )
            assert all(first_observations[4].count(name) == 1 for name in extra_observed)
            assert not extra_observed.intersection(
                name for scan in first_observations[:4] for name in scan
            )
            first_observations = [
                *first_observations[:4],
                tuple(name for name in first_observations[4] if name not in extra_observed),
            ]
            latest_names = [name for name in latest_names if name not in extra_observed]
            added = {ci60.TRANSACTION_TEST} | ci60.TRANSACTION_SHARDS
            assert len(added) == 3
            assert len(first_observations) == 5
            assert len(first_observations[4]) == 20
            assert sum(map(len, first_observations)) == 156
            assert first_observations[4] == tuple(
                name for name in latest_names if name in ci60.PRELUDE_OBSERVED
            )
            assert all(first_observations[4].count(name) == 1 for name in added)
            assert not added.intersection(name for scan in first_observations[:4] for name in scan)
            first_observations = [
                *first_observations[:4],
                tuple(name for name in first_observations[4] if name not in added),
            ]
            expected_new = tuple(
                name for name in latest_names if name in ci60.PRELUDE_NEW - {ci60.TRANSACTION_TEST}
            )
            assert len(first_observations) == 5
            assert len(expected_new) == 17
            assert first_observations[4] == expected_new
            assert sum(map(len, first_observations)) == 153
            first_observations = first_observations[:4]
            original_names = (
                ci60.history(root, "diff", "--name-only", ci60.BASE, str(ci60.FREEZE))
                .decode()
                .splitlines()
            )
            assert first_observations[:3] == [
                (ci60.ASSESSMENT,),
                (ci60.ASSESSMENT,),
                tuple(original_names),
            ]
            assert sum(map(len, first_observations[:3])) == 109
            assert set(first_observations[3]) == ci60.DERIVATION_MEMBERS
            assert len(first_observations) == 4
            assert second[ci60.SELF] == (root / ci60.SELF).read_bytes()
            copied.append(contextvars.copy_context())
            if cancel:
                raise KeyboardInterrupt("phase cancelled")

    if cancel:
        with pytest.raises(KeyboardInterrupt, match="phase cancelled"):
            run()
    else:
        run()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="inactive"):
        copied[0].run(history.proof_identity, root)

class _Ci64Mechanisms(Protocol):
    def _prelude_transition(self, operands: AdmissionOperands) -> dict[str, bytes]: ...
    def _prelude_applicability(
        self, actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str], family: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]: ...
    def _producing_inputs(
        self, actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str]
    ) -> dict[str, str]: ...

    def transition(self, operands: AdmissionOperands) -> dict[str, bytes]:
        return self._prelude_transition(operands)

    def applicability(
        self, actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str], family: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._prelude_applicability(actual, current, family)

    def producing(self, actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
        return self._producing_inputs(actual, current)

    )

    held: list[_Storage] = []

    def observed(operands: AdmissionOperands) -> dict[str, bytes]:
        calls.append(sum(len(raw) for _, _, raw in operands))
        return original(operands)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ci60, "_prelude_transition", observed)

    @preflight.invocation
    def run() -> None:
        calls.clear()  # Bootstrap and first active requests share one complete proof.
        with history.phase(root, ci60.PR_BASE, None):
            scope = vars(preflight)["_DIGESTS"]
            storage = cast(_Storage, scope.get())
            held.append(storage)
            bootstrap_entries = dict(storage.admissions)
            ci60.admitted(root)
            assert storage.admissions == bootstrap_entries
            assert all(
                storage.admissions[key] is not value for key, value in bootstrap_entries.items()
            )
            snapshot = vars(history)["_ACTIVE"].get()
            assert snapshot is not None
            current_operands = next(
                operands
                for key, operands in storage.admissions.items()
                if key[0].__name__ == "_current_derivation_transition"
            )
            historical = [
                (name.removeprefix("next-frozen/"), raw)

                if name.startswith("next-frozen/")
            ]
            assert historical
            assert all(
                raw is snapshot.contents["plain60", ci60.PRELUDE_FREEZE, name]
                for name, raw in historical
            )
            retained = storage.retained
            entries = dict(storage.admissions)
            ci60.admitted(root)
            assert len(calls) == 1
            assert calls[0] <= 128 * 1024 * 1024
            assert len(storage.admissions) == 2
            assert storage.admissions == entries
            assert storage.retained == retained <= storage.limit == 512 * 1024 * 1024
            sizes = {
                key[0].__name__: sum(len(raw) for _, _, raw in operands)
                for key, operands in entries.items()
            }
            assert sizes["_current_derivation_transition"] <= 128 * 1024 * 1024
            assert sizes["_admitted_derivation"] == 74_279_914

    run()
    assert not held[0].active
    assert held[0].retained == 0
    assert not held[0].admissions


def _ci65_storage() -> _Storage:
    scope = cast(contextvars.ContextVar[_Storage | None], vars(preflight)["_DIGESTS"])
    storage = scope.get()
    assert storage is not None
    return storage


def _ci65_validators(
    calls: list[str],
) -> tuple[AdmissionValidator, AdmissionValidator]:
    def first(operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        calls.append("first")
        if any(raw == b"reject" for _, _, raw in operands):
            raise ValueError("rejected complete operand")

    def second(operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        calls.append("second")

    return first, second
