    expected = frozen | {SELF: frozen[SELF].replace(marker, activated, 1)}
    assessment = json.loads(frozen[ASSESSMENT])
    row = assessment["changes"][SELF]
    row["after_sha256"] = digest(expected[SELF])
    row["owners"]["@module"]["after"] = owner_hashes(SELF, expected[SELF])["@module"]
    if (
        json.loads(current[ASSESSMENT]) != assessment
        or json.loads(values["assessment-first"]) != assessment
        or values["assessment-second"] != current[ASSESSMENT]
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI61 assessment changed outside exact activation.")
    expected[ASSESSMENT] = current[ASSESSMENT]
    if current != expected:
        raise ValueError("CI61 Preflight source changed.")
    for name in observed.keys() & expected.keys():
        if observed[name] != expected[name]:
            raise ValueError("CI61 Preflight source changed between observations: " + name)
    old_map = json.loads(previous[MAP])
    new_map = json.loads(frozen[MAP])
    if {key: value for key, value in old_map.items() if key != "operations"} != {
        key: value for key, value in new_map.items() if key != "operations"
    } or any(
        new_map["operations"].get(key) != value for key, value in old_map["operations"].items()
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI61 changed an existing operation, family or budget.")
    additions = new_map["operations"].keys() - old_map["operations"].keys()
    for name in additions:
        operation = new_map["operations"][name]
        if (
            not operation["mandatory"]
            or len(operation["paths"]) != 1
            or operation["paths"][0]
            not in (
                DERIVATION_INPUTS
                | {
                    name
                    for name in DERIVATION_MEMBERS
                    if name.startswith(DERIVATION_NAMESPACE + "/")
                }
            )
            or any(
                any(char in item for char in "*?[")
                for item in operation["paths"] + operation["owners"]
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("CI61 new operation must be finite, literal and mandatory.")


def _derivation_source(
    root: Path,
    observed: AdmissionOperands,
    first: tuple[str, int, bytes],
    second: tuple[str, int, bytes],
) -> tuple[dict[str, bytes], dict[str, bytes]]:
    from tools.performance_history_snapshot import proof_identity
    from tools.performance_policy import owner_hashes
    from tools.performance_preflight import admission_proof, source_members
    from tools.performance_preflight_successor import read_frozen_blobs

    freeze = DERIVATION_FREEZE
    if freeze is None or len(freeze) != 40 or set(freeze) - set("0123456789abcdef"):
        raise ValueError("CI61 provenance source freeze is pending.")
    history(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", DERIVATION_BASE, freeze)
    git(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", freeze, "HEAD")
    names = history(root, "diff", "--name-only", DERIVATION_BASE, freeze).decode().splitlines()
    if set(names) != DERIVATION_MEMBERS or len(names) != len(DERIVATION_MEMBERS):
        raise ValueError("CI61 finite source membership changed.")
    frozen = read_frozen_blobs(root, freeze, names)
    previous = read_frozen_blobs(root, DERIVATION_BASE, sorted(DERIVATION_CONTROLS))
    current = source_members(root, list(frozen))
    operands = (
        ("freeze", 0, freeze.encode()),
        ("selection", 0, json.dumps(names, separators=(",", ":")).encode()),
        (
            "selectors",
            0,
            json.dumps(
                [
                    DERIVATION_BASE,
                    DERIVATION_NAMESPACE,
                    SELF,
                    ASSESSMENT,
                    MAP,
                    sorted(DERIVATION_MEMBERS),
                    sorted(DERIVATION_CONTROLS),
                    sorted(DERIVATION_INPUTS),
                ],
                separators=(",", ":"),
            ).encode(),
        ),
        *(("frozen/" + name, 0, raw) for name, raw in frozen.items()),
        *(("previous/" + name, 0, raw) for name, raw in previous.items()),
        *(("current/" + name, mode, raw) for name, mode, raw in current),
        *(("observed/" + name, mode, raw) for name, mode, raw in observed),
        ("assessment-first", first[1], first[2]),
        ("assessment-second", second[1], second[2]),
    )
    admission_proof(
        _derivation_transition,
        operands,
        proof_identity(root),
        (digest, hashlib.sha256, json.loads, owner_hashes),
    )
    return {name: raw for name, _, raw in current}, previous


def _preceding_self(actual: dict[str, bytes]) -> bytes:
    """Exact native E preimage already authenticated by the finite transition."""
    record = json.loads(actual[DERIVATION_NAMESPACE + "/control-transitions.json"])
    row = record["changes"][SELF]
    activated = f'\nDERIVATION_FREEZE: str | None = "{DERIVATION_FREEZE}"'.encode()
    marker = b"\nDERIVATION_FREEZE: str | None = None"
    raw = actual[SELF]
    if raw.count(activated) != 1:
        raise ValueError("CI61 producing SELF is not the exact unactivated frozen source.")
    raw = raw.replace(activated, marker, 1)
    for edit in reversed(row["edits"]):
        before, after = edit["before"].encode(), edit["after"].encode()
        if not before or not after or raw.count(after) != 1:
            raise ValueError("CI61 exact SELF transition changed.")
        raw = raw.replace(after, before, 1)
    if digest(raw) != row["before_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("CI61 original SELF preimage changed.")
    return raw


def _admitted_derivation(operands: AdmissionOperands, identity: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
    """The complete original finite proof, with no filesystem or Git observation."""
    from tools.performance_policy import owner_hashes

    values = {name: raw for name, _, raw in operands}
    freeze = values["freeze"].decode()
    names = json.loads(values["selection"])
    frozen = {name[7:]: raw for name, _, raw in operands if name.startswith("frozen/")}
    old = {name[4:]: raw for name, _, raw in operands if name.startswith("old/")}
    current = {name[8:]: raw for name, _, raw in operands if name.startswith("current/")}
    declaration = NAMESPACE + "/changed-members.json"
    if json.loads(frozen[declaration]) != sorted(names) or len(names) != len(set(names)):
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification finite membership changed.")
    marker = b"\nFREEZE: str | None = None"
    if frozen[SELF].count(marker) != 1:
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification original activation changed.")
    actual = dict(frozen)
    actual[SELF] = frozen[SELF].replace(marker, f'\nFREEZE: str | None = "{freeze}"'.encode(), 1)
    assessment = json.loads(frozen[ASSESSMENT])
    row = assessment["changes"][SELF]
    row["after_sha256"] = digest(actual[SELF])
    row["owners"]["@module"]["after"] = owner_hashes(SELF, actual[SELF])["@module"]
    if json.loads(values["assessment-first"]) != assessment:
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification assessment changed outside exact activation.")
    actual[ASSESSMENT] = values["assessment-second"]
    if current.keys() != actual.keys():
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification finite membership changed.")
    for name, raw in actual.items():
        if current[name] != raw:
            raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification Preflight source changed: " + name)
    transitions = json.loads(frozen[NAMESPACE + "/control-transitions.json"])
    if set(transitions) != set(CONTROLS - {ASSESSMENT}):
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification control membership changed.")
    for name, row in transitions.items():
        if row.keys() != {"before_sha256", "after_sha256", "edits"}:
            raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification control recipe schema changed.")
        if digest(old[name]) != row["before_sha256"] or digest(frozen[name]) != row["after_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification control recipe pin changed.")
        projected = old[name]
        for edit in row["edits"]:
            if edit.keys() != {"before", "after"} or not all(
                isinstance(value, str) for value in edit.values()
            ):
                raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification exact edit is malformed.")
            before, after = edit["before"].encode(), edit["after"].encode()
            if projected.count(before) != 1:
                raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification exact edit lacks one preimage.")
            projected = projected.replace(before, after, 1)
        if projected != frozen[name]:
            raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification control changed outside its exact recipe.")
    old_map, new_map = json.loads(old[MAP]), json.loads(frozen[MAP])
    additions = json.loads(frozen[NAMESPACE + "/added-operations.json"])
    if {k: v for k, v in old_map.items() if k != "operations"} != {
        k: v for k, v in new_map.items() if k != "operations"
    }:
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification historical families or budgets changed.")
    if new_map["operations"] != old_map["operations"] | additions:
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification historical operation changed.")
    for operation in additions.values():
        if (
            not operation["mandatory"]
            or len(operation["paths"]) != 1
            or any(
                any(c in literal for c in "*?[")
                for literal in operation["paths"] + operation["owners"]
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification operation must remain literal and mandatory.")


def admitted(root: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    """Fresh complete observations precede invocation-local pure proof reuse."""
    from tools.performance_history_snapshot import proof_identity
    from tools.performance_policy import owner_hashes
    from tools.performance_preflight import admission_proof, source_members
    from tools.performance_preflight_successor import read_frozen_blobs

    freeze = FREEZE
    if freeze is None or len(freeze) != 40 or set(freeze) - set("0123456789abcdef"):
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification source freeze is pending.")
    history(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", BASE, freeze)
    git(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", freeze, "HEAD")
    names = history(root, "diff", "--name-only", BASE, freeze).decode().splitlines()
    frozen = read_frozen_blobs(root, freeze, names)
    first = source_members(root, [ASSESSMENT])[0]
    second = source_members(root, [ASSESSMENT])[0]
    current = source_members(root, list(frozen))
    old = read_frozen_blobs(root, BASE, sorted(CONTROLS))
    derived, preceding = _derivation_source(root, current, first, second)
    projected = tuple((name, mode, preceding.get(name, raw)) for name, mode, raw in current)
    first = first[0], first[1], preceding[ASSESSMENT]
    second = second[0], second[1], preceding[ASSESSMENT]
    selectors = json.dumps(
        [BASE, SELF, NAMESPACE, ASSESSMENT, MAP, sorted(CONTROLS)], separators=(",", ":")
    ).encode()
    operands = (
        ("freeze", 0, freeze.encode()),
        ("selection", 0, json.dumps(names, separators=(",", ":")).encode()),
        ("selectors", 0, selectors),
        *((("frozen/" + name, 0, raw) for name, raw in frozen.items())),
        *((("old/" + name, 0, raw) for name, raw in old.items())),
        ("assessment-first", first[1], first[2]),
        ("assessment-second", second[1], second[2]),
        *((("current/" + name, mode, raw) for name, mode, raw in projected)),
    )
    identity = proof_identity(root)
    admission_proof(
        _admitted_derivation, operands, identity, (digest, hashlib.sha256, json.loads, owner_hashes)
    )
    return {name: raw for name, _, raw in current} | derived


def control_projection(root: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    from tools.performance_preflight_successor import read_frozen_blobs

    admitted(root)
    return read_frozen_blobs(root, BASE, sorted(CONTROLS)) | read_frozen_blobs(
        root, DERIVATION_BASE, sorted(DERIVATION_CONTROLS - CONTROLS - {SELF})
    )


def preceding_control(root: Path, name: str, supplied: bytes) -> bytes:
    if name == CURRENT_INVENTORY and (root / NAMESPACE).is_dir():
        return historical_inventory_preimage(root, supplied)
    if name not in CONTROLS:
        if name in DERIVATION_CONTROLS - {SELF}:
            actual = owned(root, name)
            if supplied != actual:
                raise ValueError("CI61 predecessor caller supplied unrelated bytes.")
            return control_projection(root)[name]
        return supplied
    actual = owned(root, name)
    if supplied != actual:
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification caller supplied unrelated bytes.")
    projection = control_projection(root)
    return projection[name]

def historical_inventory_preimage(root: Path, supplied: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Original DATA pin after exact current fourteen-field source refresh proof."""
    actual = admitted(root)
    if supplied != actual[CURRENT_INVENTORY]:
        raise ValueError("CI60 historical inventory caller supplied unrelated bytes.")
    before = history(root, "show", BASE + ":" + CURRENT_INVENTORY)
    if digest(before) != CURRENT_INVENTORY_BEFORE:
        raise ValueError("CI60 historical inventory native preimage changed.")
    expected = json.loads(before)
    for path, cases in INVENTORY_TEST_CASES.items():
        raw = actual[path]
        expected["current_files_observed"][path]["bytes"] = len(raw)
        expected["current_files_observed"][path]["sha256"] = digest(raw)
        for case in cases:
            expected["tests"][path + "::" + case]["file_sha256"] = digest(raw)

        raise ValueError("CI60 current inventory changed outside fourteen source fields.")

def current_source(root: Path, previous: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    from tools.performance_preflight_successor import read_frozen_blobs

    actual = admitted(root)
    prior_names = sorted(set(actual) & previous.keys())
    before = read_frozen_blobs(root, BASE, prior_names)
    if any(previous[name] != digest(before[name]) for name in prior_names):
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification predecessor source changed.")
    return previous | {name: digest(raw) for name, raw in actual.items()}


def measurement_controls(root: Path, current: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Only declared control bytes project; every current engine/fixture byte survives."""
    actual = admitted(root)
    projected = control_projection(root)
    result = dict(current)
    for name in (DERIVATION_CONTROLS - CONTROLS - {SELF}) & current.keys():
        if current[name] != digest(actual[name]):
            raise ValueError("CI61 actual input collector omitted current control bytes.")
        result[name] = digest(projected[name])
    for name in (CONTROLS | {SELF}) & current.keys():
        if current[name] != digest(actual[name]):
            raise ValueError("CI60 actual input collector omitted current control bytes.")
        if name == SELF:
            del result[name]
        else:
            result[name] = digest(projected[name])
    return result


def _cohort(actual: dict[str, bytes]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(actual[NAMESPACE + "/family-plan.json"])
    families: dict[str, Any] = value["families"]
    if (
        value["base"] != PR_BASE
        or len(families) != 12
        or {name for name, row in families.items() if row["disposition"] == "retained"}
        != set(RETAINED)
        or sum(len(row["cases"]) for row in families.values()) != 41
        or sum(len(row["cases"]) * row["samples_per_case"] for row in families.values()) != 247
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification family inventory changed.")
    families["external_contract_source_reuse"]["comparison"] = DERIVATION_REPORT
    return families

def applies(root: Path, *, base: str, family: str, path: str) -> bool:

def _original_producing_inputs(actual: dict[str, bytes]) -> dict[str, str]:
    measured: dict[str, str] = json.loads(actual[NAMESPACE + "/producing-inputs.json"])
    activated = f'\nFREEZE: str | None = "{FREEZE}"'.encode()
    marker = b"\nFREEZE: str | None = None"
    original = _preceding_self(actual)
    if original.count(activated) != 1 or measured.get(SELF) != digest(
        original.replace(activated, marker, 1)
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI60 producing SELF is not the exact unactivated frozen source.")
    return measured


def _producing_inputs(actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    _original_producing_inputs(actual)
    measured: dict[str, str] = json.loads(actual[DERIVATION_NAMESPACE + "/producing-inputs.json"])
    activated = f'\nDERIVATION_FREEZE: str | None = "{DERIVATION_FREEZE}"'.encode()
    marker = b"\nDERIVATION_FREEZE: str | None = None"
    if actual[SELF].count(activated) != 1 or measured.get(SELF) != digest(
        actual[SELF].replace(activated, marker, 1)
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI61 producing SELF is not the exact unactivated frozen source.")
    if current != measured | {SELF: digest(actual[SELF])}:
        raise ValueError("CI61 complete producing inputs differ from the actual current collector.")
    return measured


def _current_applicability(
    actual: dict[str, bytes], current: dict[str, str], family: str
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Complete current inputs differ only in the finite uncalled provenance controls."""
    produced = _producing_inputs(actual, current)
    previous = _original_producing_inputs(actual)
    proof: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(actual[DERIVATION_NAMESPACE + "/applicability.json"])
    families = _cohort(actual)
    selected = set(families) - {"external_contract_source_reuse"}
    changed = {
        name: {"before": previous.get(name), "after": produced.get(name)}
        for name in previous.keys() | produced.keys()
        if previous.get(name) != produced.get(name)
    }
    unchanged = {name: pin for name, pin in previous.items() if produced.get(name) == pin}
    if (
        proof.keys()
        != {
            "schema",
            "original_input_digest",
            "current_producing_input_digest",
            "changes",
            "unchanged_inputs",
            "families",
        }
        or proof["schema"] != "ci61-finite-current-applicability-v1"
        or proof["original_input_digest"] != canonical(previous)
        or proof["current_producing_input_digest"] != canonical(produced)
        or proof["changes"] != changed
        or not changed.keys() <= DERIVATION_INPUTS
        or proof["unchanged_inputs"] != unchanged
        or set(proof["families"]) != selected
        or family not in selected
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI61 complete current applicability changed.")
    for name, row in proof["families"].items():
        required = {
            families[name]["driver"],
            "tests/conftest.py",
            "tests/__init__.py",
            "tests/timing_plugin.py",
            "pyproject.toml",
            "uv.lock",
        }
        if (
            row.keys() != {"driver", "unchanged_startup", "call_path"}
            or row["driver"] != families[name]["driver"]
            or row["unchanged_startup"] != {path: unchanged[path] for path in sorted(required)}
            or not isinstance(row["call_path"], str)
            or not row["call_path"]
        ):
            raise ValueError("CI61 timed consumer/startup proof changed.")
    return proof


def extend_catalog(builder: Any) -> None:
    """Append the finite CI60 native objects after the unchanged historical catalog."""
    freeze = FREEZE
    if freeze is None:
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification catalog freeze is pending.")
    builder.fact("plain60", ("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", BASE, freeze), "ci60.ancestry")
    raw = builder.fact("plain60", ("diff", "--name-only", BASE, freeze), "ci60.membership")
    names = raw.decode().splitlines()
    frozen = builder.add("plain60", freeze, dict.fromkeys(names), "ci60.freeze")
    if json.loads(frozen[NAMESPACE + "/changed-members.json"]) != sorted(names):
        raise ValueError("CI60 Qualification native membership changed.")
    builder.add("plain60", BASE, dict.fromkeys(CONTROLS), "ci60.control-preimages")
    # current_source verifies the exact original predecessor for every existing member.
    existing = set(builder.all_paths("plain60", BASE)) & set(names)
    builder.add("plain60", BASE, dict.fromkeys(existing), "ci60.source-preimages")
    derivation = DERIVATION_FREEZE
    if derivation is None:
        raise ValueError("CI61 provenance catalog freeze is pending.")
    builder.fact(
        "plain60",
        ("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", DERIVATION_BASE, derivation),
        "ci61.ancestry",
    )
    changed = (
        builder.fact(
            "plain60", ("diff", "--name-only", DERIVATION_BASE, derivation), "ci61.membership"
        )
        .decode()
        .splitlines()
    )
    if set(changed) != DERIVATION_MEMBERS or len(changed) != len(DERIVATION_MEMBERS):
        raise ValueError("CI61 native catalog membership changed.")
    builder.add("plain60", derivation, dict.fromkeys(changed), "ci61.freeze")
    builder.add("plain60", DERIVATION_BASE, dict.fromkeys(DERIVATION_CONTROLS), "ci61.preimages")
    earlier = set(builder.all_paths("plain60", BASE)) & set(changed)
    builder.add("plain60", BASE, dict.fromkeys(earlier), "ci61.source-preimages")


def source_binding(actual: dict[str, bytes], input_digest: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    spec = json.loads(actual[DERIVATION_NAMESPACE + "/source-token-roles.json"])
    inventories = json.loads(actual[spec["inventories_path"]])
    before, after = inventories["base"], inventories["head"]
    common = {name: pin for name, pin in before.items() if after.get(name) == pin}
    changed = (before.keys() | after.keys()) - common.keys()
    if (
        spec["schema"] != "tool-input-roles-v3"
        or spec["base_revision"] != PR_BASE
        or canonical(inventories) != spec["inventories_sha256"]
        or canonical(common) != spec["common_sha256"]
        or spec["roles"].keys() != changed
        or any(
            role
            not in {"runtime-or-generator-treatment", "side-derived-output", "untimed-governance"}
            for role in spec["roles"].values()
        )
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI60 complete source-token input roles changed.")
    return {
        "schema": spec["schema"],
        "family": "external_contract_source_reuse",
        "base_revision": PR_BASE,
        "head_input_digest": input_digest,
        "role_spec_sha256": canonical(spec),
        "complete_inventories_sha256": canonical(inventories),
        "common_sha256": canonical(common),
        "contract_trees": spec["contract_trees"],
        "runtime_identities": spec["runtime_identities"],
        "shared_dependencies_sha256": spec["shared_dependencies_sha256"],
        "shared_workload_sha256": spec["shared_workload_sha256"],
    }


def retained_role_proof(
    root: Path,
    family: str,
    actual: dict[str, bytes],
    current: dict[str, str],
    measured: dict[str, str],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from tools.performance_policy import owner_hashes

    proofs = json.loads(actual[NAMESPACE + "/retained-role-proofs.json"])
    if proofs.keys() != set(RETAINED) or family not in RETAINED:
        raise ValueError("CI60 retained applicability is limited to two exact families.")
    proof: dict[str, Any] = proofs[family]
    changed = {
        name for name in current.keys() | measured.keys() if current.get(name) != measured.get(name)
    }
    if (
        proof["current_input_digest"] != canonical(current)
        or proof["producing_input_digest"] != canonical(measured)
        or proof["changed_inputs"].keys() != changed
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI60 retained family roles omit or invent current inputs.")
    for name, row in proof["changed_inputs"].items():
        if (
            row["before"] != measured.get(name)
            or row["after"] != current.get(name)
            or row["role"]
            not in {
                "uncalled-owner",
                "identity-only",
                "untimed-governance",
                "unchanged-called-owner-in-changed-module",
            }
            or len(row["reason"].strip()) < 30
        ):
            raise ValueError("CI60 retained family changed-input role changed.")
    for name, owners in proof["called_owners"].items():
        current_owners = owner_hashes(name, owned(root, name))
        if any(current_owners.get(owner) != pin for owner, pin in owners.items()):
            raise ValueError("CI60 retained family called owner changed: " + name)
    if not proof["called_owners"] or len(proof["call_path"].strip()) < 100:
        raise ValueError("CI60 retained family call proof is incomplete.")

def _literal_member_plan(root_name: str, name: str) -> _PathPlan:

    return (

class _Digests:
    def __init__(self, limit: int = _DIGEST_LIMIT) -> None:
        self.limit = limit
        self.retained = 0

        self.active = True
        self.path_plans: dict[_PathKey, _PathPlan] | None = None
        self.path_plan_charge = 0
        self.owner = (os.getpid(), threading.get_ident())
        self.ci60_handoff: _Ci60AdmissionHandoff | None = None
        self.admissions: dict[
            tuple[AdmissionValidator, tuple[str, ...], tuple[Callable[..., Any], ...]],
            AdmissionOperands,
        ] = {}

    def admission(
        self,
        validator: AdmissionValidator,
        operands: AdmissionOperands,
        identity: tuple[str, ...],
        dependencies: tuple[Callable[..., Any], ...],
    ) -> None:
        key = validator, identity, dependencies
        previous = self.admissions.get(key) if self.active else None
        if previous is not None and previous == operands:
            # Adopt equal active-snapshot byte objects after the complete comparison.
            self.admissions[key] = operands
            return
        if previous is not None:
            self.retained -= sum(len(raw) for _, _, raw in previous)
            del self.admissions[key]
        validator(operands, identity)
        required = sum(len(raw) for _, _, raw in operands)
        if self.active and required <= self.limit - self.retained:
            self.admissions[key] = operands
            self.retained += required

    def member_plan(self, root: Path, root_name: str, name: str) -> _PathPlan:
        key = type(root), root.as_posix(), name, _POSIX_PATH_DEPENDENCIES
        if self.path_plans is not None and key in self.path_plans:
            return self.path_plans[key]
        plan = _literal_member_plan(root_name, name)
        prospective = {} if self.path_plans is None else dict(self.path_plans)
        prospective[key] = plan
        old_dictionary = 0 if self.path_plans is None else sys.getsizeof(self.path_plans)
        required = _path_plan_size(key, plan) + sys.getsizeof(prospective) - old_dictionary
        if required <= self.limit - self.retained:
            self.path_plans = prospective
            self.path_plan_charge += required
            self.retained += required
        return plan

    def digest(self, path: str, raw: bytes) -> str:
        function = hashlib.sha256

        previous = self.entries.get(key)
        if previous is not None and previous[0] == raw:
            return previous[1]

        if previous is not None:
            self.retained -= len(previous[0])
            del self.entries[key]
        if len(raw) <= self.limit - self.retained:
            self.entries[key] = (raw, result)
            self.retained += len(raw)
        return result

def invocation[F: Callable[..., Any]](function: F) -> F:

    @wraps(function)

            digests.path_plan_charge = 0
            digests.retained = 0
            _DIGESTS.reset(digests_token)
            _OWNERS.reset(owners_token)
            _PROOFS.reset(token)

    """Single-use ownership for the two audited CI60 pure proofs."""

        self, root: Path, validators: tuple[AdmissionValidator, AdmissionValidator]

        raise ValueError("CI60 admission invocation belongs to another owner.")

        raise ValueError("CI60 admission requires one bootstrap and two validators.")

    try:

    finally:
        state.revoke(digests)
        digests.ci60_handoff = None

class _AdmissionTransaction:
    """Private complete CI60 result for one explicitly bounded verification."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        storage: _Digests,
        phase: tuple[str, ...],
        fresh: Callable[[Path], dict[str, bytes]],
        bindings: Callable[[], tuple[object, ...]],
    ) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.storage = storage
        self.phase = phase
        self.fresh = fresh
        self.bindings = bindings
        self.dependencies = bindings()
        self.owner = (os.getpid(), threading.get_ident())
        self.repository = self.repository_identity(root)
        self.active = True
        self.result: dict[str, bytes] = {}
        self.charge = 0

    @staticmethod
    def repository_identity(root: Path) -> tuple[object, ...]:
        if root.absolute() != root.resolve(strict=True):
            raise ValueError("Admission transaction requires a physical repository.")
        result: list[object] = [root.as_posix()]
        for path in (root, root / ".git"):
            value = path.lstat()
            if path.is_symlink() or path.is_junction():
                raise ValueError("Admission transaction metadata became aliased.")
            result.extend(
                (path.resolve(strict=True).as_posix(), value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode)
            )
            if path != root and stat.S_ISREG(value.st_mode):
                if value.st_size > _GIT_POINTER_LIMIT:
                    raise ValueError("Admission transaction metadata pointer became oversized.")
                pointer = tuple(
                    _source_members(
                        root, [".git"], observe_ancestors=True, read_limit=_GIT_POINTER_LIMIT
                    )
                )

                    type(pointer) is not tuple
                    or len(pointer) != 1
                    or len(pointer[0]) != 3
                    or pointer[0][0] != ".git"
                    or type(pointer[0][1]) is not int
                    or type(pointer[0][2]) is not bytes
                    or len(pointer[0][2]) > _GIT_POINTER_LIMIT
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Admission transaction metadata pointer observation changed.")
                result.append(pointer)

            tuple(
                sorted(
                    (name, value)
                    for name, value in os.environ.items()
                    if name.startswith(("GIT_", "LC_"))
                    or name in {"PATH", "HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "LANG", "SYSTEMROOT"}

    def check(self, root: Path, *, closing: bool = False) -> None:
        from tools.performance_history_snapshot import proof_identity

        if (
            self.active == closing
            or self.owner != (os.getpid(), threading.get_ident())
            or not self.storage.active
            or self.storage.owner != self.owner
            or _DIGESTS.get() is not self.storage

            or proof_identity(root) != self.phase
            or self.bindings() != self.dependencies
        ):

    def retain(self, values: dict[str, bytes]) -> bool:
        if type(values) is not dict or any(
            type(name) is not str or type(raw) is not bytes for name, raw in values.items()
        ):
            raise ValueError("Admission transaction requires an immutable byte result.")

        # including bytes already retained by another independent pure proof.
        required = (
            sys.getsizeof(self)
            + sys.getsizeof(values)
            + sum(sys.getsizeof(name) + sys.getsizeof(raw) for name, raw in values.items())
        )
        required += _transaction_payload_size((self.repository, self.phase, self.dependencies))
        for key, (raw, _) in tuple(self.storage.entries.items()):
            if required <= self.storage.limit - self.storage.retained:
                break
            self.storage.retained -= len(raw)
            del self.storage.entries[key]
        if required > self.storage.limit - self.storage.retained:
            return False
        self.result = dict(values)
        self.charge = required
        self.storage.retained += required
        return True

    def revoke(self) -> None:
        self.active = False
        self.result.clear()
        self.repository = ()
        self.phase = ()
        self.dependencies = ()
        self.storage.retained -= self.charge
        self.charge = 0

    """Charge the immutable tuple/string/byte data owned by this finite lease."""
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return sys.getsizeof(value) + sum(_transaction_payload_size(item) for item in value)

@contextmanager
def ci60_transaction(
    root: Path,
    fresh: Callable[[Path], dict[str, bytes]],
    bindings: Callable[[], tuple[object, ...]],
) -> Iterator[None]:
    """Fresh complete start/end checks bound reuse to one verify_live body.

    A reverted transient mutation wholly inside this boundary may be unobserved.
    Insufficient capacity publishes no transaction: the original fully fresh
    nested calls remain authoritative, without a grouped equality guarantee.
    """
    from tools.performance_history_snapshot import proof_identity

    if _ADMISSION_TRANSACTION.get() is not None or _ADMISSION_GUARD.get() is not None:
        raise ValueError("Nested admission transactions are not admitted.")
    storage = _DIGESTS.get()
    if storage is None or not storage.active:
        yield
        return
    if storage.owner != (os.getpid(), threading.get_ident()):
        raise ValueError("Admission transaction invocation identity changed.")
    phase = proof_identity(root)
    handoff = storage.ci60_handoff
    if handoff is not None and handoff.computation_only:
        if phase is not None:
            handoff.revoke(storage)
        yield
        return
    if phase is None:
        yield
        return
    metadata = (root / ".git").lstat()
    if (
        (root / ".git").is_symlink()
        or (root / ".git").is_junction()
        or not (
            stat.S_ISDIR(metadata.st_mode)
            or (
                stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode)
                and metadata.st_nlink == 1
                and metadata.st_size <= _GIT_POINTER_LIMIT
            )
        )
    ):
        yield
        return
    state = _AdmissionTransaction(root, storage, phase, fresh, bindings)
    cleanup_state: _AdmissionTransaction | None = state
    token = None
    guard_token = _ADMISSION_GUARD.set(state)
    guard_active = True
    try:
        values = fresh(root)
        state.check(root)
        if not state.retain(values):
            del values
            state.revoke()
            cleanup_state = None
            del state
            _ADMISSION_GUARD.reset(guard_token)
            guard_active = False
            yield
            return
        del values
        token = _ADMISSION_TRANSACTION.set(state)
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            # Disable dispatch before complete end acquisition. On a body error,
            # a passing end preserves that exact exception; a failed end retains
            # it as Python's explicit exception context rather than swallowing it.
            state.check(root)
            state.active = False
            previous_token, token = token, None
            _ADMISSION_TRANSACTION.reset(previous_token)
            observed = fresh(root)
            state.check(root, closing=True)
            if observed != state.result:
                raise ValueError("Admission transaction complete result changed.")
    finally:
        if cleanup_state is not None:
            cleanup_state.revoke()
        try:
            if token is not None:
                _ADMISSION_TRANSACTION.reset(token)
        finally:
            if guard_active:
                _ADMISSION_GUARD.reset(guard_token)

def ci60_computation[T](root: Path, acquire: Callable[[], T]) -> T:
    """One test-local CPU scope; every live admission remains fully fresh."""

    from tools.performance_history_snapshot import proof_identity

        _DIGESTS.get() is not None
        or proof_identity(root) is not None
        or not (root / q.NAMESPACE).is_dir()
    ):
        return acquire()

    def compute() -> T:
        owners = _OWNERS.set(None)
        proofs = _PROOFS.set(None)
        try:
            with ci60_bootstrap_admission(
                root, q.admission_validators(), acquire, computation_only=True

def recipe_proof[F: Callable[..., None]](function: F) -> F:
    """Reuse a successful pure whole-AST comparison only for identical inputs."""

    @wraps(function)
    def wrapped(before: bytes, current: bytes, recipe: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        proofs = _PROOFS.get()
        key = (function, before, current, json.dumps(recipe, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))
        if proofs is not None and key in proofs:
            return
        function(before, current, recipe)
        if proofs is not None:
            proofs.add(key)

    return cast(F, wrapped)


def owner_proof[F: Callable[..., dict[str, str]]](function: F) -> F:
    """Memoize pure AST hashes by complete bytes; callers receive defensive copies."""

    @wraps(function)
    def wrapped(path: str, content: bytes | None) -> dict[str, str]:
        owners = _OWNERS.get()
        key = (function, path, content)
        if owners is not None and key in owners:
            return dict(owners[key])
        result = function(path, content)
        if owners is not None:
            owners[key] = dict(result)
        return result

    return cast(F, wrapped)


def discovered_sources(root: Path) -> set[str]:
    """Enumerate the same ignored-source corpus without per-member Path bookkeeping."""
    result: set[str] = set()
    for prefix, pattern in (
        ("src", "*"),
        ("tests", "*.py"),
        ("tools", "*.py"),
        ("scripts", "*.py"),
        ("contracts", "*"),
        ("conformance/typescript/src", "*.ts"),
    ):
        start = root / prefix
        if not start.is_dir():
            continue
        pending = [(str(start), prefix)]
        while pending:
            directory, relative = pending.pop()
            with os.scandir(directory) as entries:
                for entry in entries:
                    name = relative + "/" + entry.name
                    if entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                        if os.path.isjunction(entry.path):
                            raise ValueError("Aliased cumulative source directory.")
                        pending.append((entry.path, name))
                    if fnmatch.fnmatch(entry.name, pattern) and (
                        entry.is_file() or entry.is_symlink()
                    ):
                        result.add(name)
    return result

                raise ValueError("D07 member must be an owned regular file: " + name)

        with member.open("rb") as stream:
            opened = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            if read_limit is None:
                raw = stream.read()
            else:
                if type(read_limit) is not int or read_limit < 0:

            after.st_ino,
            after.st_mode,

    """Fresh owned reads with the existing invocation-local digest budget."""
    return {
        name: _source_digest(name, raw)
        for name, _, raw in _source_members(root, sorted(names), observe_ancestors=False)

def source_members(root: Path, names: list[str]) -> AdmissionOperands:
    """Complete ordered bytes with fresh ancestry at every member observation."""
    return tuple(_source_members(root, names, observe_ancestors=True))


def _same_read(
    before: os.stat_result,
    opened: os.stat_result,
    closed: os.stat_result,
    after: os.stat_result,
    *,
    windows: bool,
) -> bool:
    # Windows Python can expose creation time through lstat's ctime and change
    # time through fstat's ctime. Both channels must remain stable independently;
    # compare all other identity/content metadata across the two APIs as well.
    return (
        (not windows or _same_file(before, after))
        and _same_file(before, opened, compare_ctime=not windows)
        and _same_file(opened, closed)
        and _same_file(closed, after, compare_ctime=not windows)
    )


def _same_file(
    before: os.stat_result, after: os.stat_result, *, compare_ctime: bool = True
) -> bool:
    return (
        before.st_dev,
        before.st_ino,
        before.st_mode,
        before.st_nlink,
        before.st_size,
        before.st_mtime_ns,
        before.st_ctime_ns if compare_ctime else None,
    ) == (
        after.st_dev,
        after.st_ino,
        after.st_mode,
        after.st_nlink,
        after.st_size,
        after.st_mtime_ns,
        after.st_ctime_ns if compare_ctime else None,
    )

def _sha(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def _git(root: Path, *args: str, payload: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=root, input=payload, timeout=60)


def _history(root: Path, *args: str) -> bytes:
    from tools.performance_history_snapshot import historical

    return historical(root, "plain60", args, lambda: _git(root, *args))


def _blobs(root: Path, revision: str, names: list[str]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    """Read exact immutable members afresh; never cache Git or filesystem results."""
    from tools.performance_history_snapshot import eligible_blobs

    selected = eligible_blobs(root, revision, names)
    if selected is not None:
        return selected
    if len(revision) != 40 or set(revision) - set("0123456789abcdef"):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git revision must be an exact SHA1 selector.")
    if not names or len(set(names)) != len(names):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git selection must contain unique members.")
    for name in names:
        if any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in name.split("/")) or any(
            character in name for character in "\\\x00\r\n"
        ):
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git member must be a canonical literal path.")
    tree = _git(root, "--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", revision, "--", *names)
    if not tree.endswith(b"\0"):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git tree membership is incomplete.")
    objects: dict[str, str] = {}
    for row in tree[:-1].split(b"\0"):
        metadata, separator, encoded_name = row.partition(b"\t")
        fields = metadata.split(b" ")
        if not separator or len(fields) != 3:
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git tree row is malformed.")
        mode, kind, encoded_oid = fields
        name, oid = encoded_name.decode(), encoded_oid.decode("ascii")
        if (
            mode not in {b"100644", b"100755"}
            or kind != b"blob"
            or len(oid) != 40
            or set(oid) - set("0123456789abcdef")
            or name not in names
            or name in objects
        ):
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git member identity or type changed.")
        objects[name] = oid
    if objects.keys() != set(names):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git tree membership is incomplete.")
    raw = _git(
        root,
        "cat-file",
        "--batch",
        payload="".join(objects[name] + "\n" for name in names).encode(),
    )
    result: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    offset = 0
    for name in names:
        boundary = raw.find(b"\n", offset)
        if boundary == -1:
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob header is incomplete.")
        fields = raw[offset:boundary].split(b" ")
        if len(fields) != 3:
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob header is malformed.")
        encoded_oid, kind, size = fields
        if encoded_oid != objects[name].encode() or kind != b"blob":
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob identity or type changed.")
        if not size.isdigit() or (len(size) > 1 and size.startswith(b"0")):
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob size is not canonical.")
        start = boundary + 1
        end = start + int(size)
        if end >= len(raw) or raw[end : end + 1] != b"\n":
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob payload is incomplete.")
        content = raw[start:end]
        object_hash = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + size + b"\0", usedforsecurity=False)
        object_hash.update(content)
        if object_hash.hexdigest() != objects[name]:
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob bytes differ from the selected object.")
        result[name] = content
        offset = end + 1
    if offset != len(raw):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob payload has trailing data.")
    return result


def read_frozen_blobs(root: Path, revision: str, names: list[str]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    """Read a literal immutable group afresh with the complete existing Git checks."""
    return _blobs(root, revision, names)


def _read(root: Path, name: str) -> bytes:
    from tests.d07_geometry_containment import read_owned_geometry_member

    if root.absolute() != root.resolve(strict=True):
        raise ValueError("Aliased preflight successor root.")
    return read_owned_geometry_member(root, name)


def _ci54_previous(root: Path, name: str, raw: bytes, *, predecessor: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    from tools.quality_runtime_successor import previous

    return previous(root, name, raw, predecessor=predecessor)


def preceding_control(root: Path, name: str, raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Exact byte projection; the complete successor freeze is admitted separately."""
    if name not in PINS and name != ASSESSMENT:
        return raw
    actual = _read(root, name)
    if name == ASSESSMENT:
        _assessment(root, _freeze(root))
    elif _sha(_ci54_previous(root, name, actual)) != PINS[name]:
        raise ValueError(
            "Reviewed migration source/data changed: "
            "Qualification / Perils successor / Preflight source: " + name
        )
    old = _history(root, "show", BASE + ":" + name)
    if raw not in (actual, old):
        raise ValueError("Preflight control caller supplied unrelated bytes.")
    return old


def assert_static_transition(name: str, before: bytes, current: bytes, row: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Check one finite static edit against its independent immutable preimage."""
    from tools.cumulative_preservation import assert_recipe

    if (
        name not in STATIC_BEFORE
        or row.keys() != {"before_sha256", "after_sha256", "recipe"}
        or row["before_sha256"] != STATIC_BEFORE[name]
        or _sha(before) != STATIC_BEFORE[name]
        or row["after_sha256"] != _sha(current)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Static transition identity or bytes changed.")
    recipe: dict[str, Any] = row["recipe"]
    if (
        not isinstance(recipe, dict)
        or recipe.keys() != {"edits"}
        or not isinstance(recipe["edits"], list)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Static transition recipe is malformed.")
    for edit in cast(list[dict[str, Any]], recipe["edits"]):
        if not isinstance(edit, dict) or "kind" not in edit:
            raise ValueError("Static transition edit is malformed.")
        kind = edit.get("kind")
        keys = {"kind", "at", "before", "after"}
        if kind == "splice":
            keys |= {"start", "end"}
        if (
            kind not in {"replace", "splice"}
            or edit.keys() != keys
            or not isinstance(edit["at"], list)
            or not edit["at"]
            or any(type(part) not in {str, int} for part in edit["at"])
        ):
            raise ValueError("Static transition edit is malformed.")
        if kind == "splice" and (
            type(edit["start"]) is not int
            or type(edit["end"]) is not int
            or not 0 <= edit["start"] <= edit["end"]
            or not isinstance(edit["before"], list)
            or not isinstance(edit["after"], list)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Static transition splice is malformed.")
    assert_recipe(before, current, recipe)


def _static_transitions(root: Path, frozen_members: dict[str, bytes]) -> None:
    record: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(frozen_members[STATIC_RECORD])
    if (
        record.keys() != {"schema", "base", "changes"}
        or record["schema"] != "exact-static-successor-v1"
        or record["base"] != STATIC_BASE
        or record["changes"].keys() != STATIC_BEFORE.keys()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Static transition membership or base changed.")
    previous = _blobs(root, STATIC_BASE, list(STATIC_BEFORE))
    for name in STATIC_BEFORE:
        assert_static_transition(
            name, previous[name], frozen_members[name], record["changes"][name]
        )

def _sha(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def _git(root: Path, *args: str, payload: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=root, input=payload, timeout=60)


def _history(root: Path, *args: str) -> bytes:
    from tools.performance_history_snapshot import historical

    return historical(root, "plain60", args, lambda: _git(root, *args))


def _blobs(root: Path, revision: str, names: list[str]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    """Read exact immutable members afresh; never cache Git or filesystem results."""
    from tools.performance_history_snapshot import eligible_blobs

    selected = eligible_blobs(root, revision, names)
    if selected is not None:
        return selected
    if len(revision) != 40 or set(revision) - set("0123456789abcdef"):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git revision must be an exact SHA1 selector.")
    if not names or len(set(names)) != len(names):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git selection must contain unique members.")
    for name in names:
        if any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in name.split("/")) or any(
            character in name for character in "\\\x00\r\n"
        ):
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git member must be a canonical literal path.")
    tree = _git(root, "--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", revision, "--", *names)
    if not tree.endswith(b"\0"):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git tree membership is incomplete.")
    objects: dict[str, str] = {}
    for row in tree[:-1].split(b"\0"):
        metadata, separator, encoded_name = row.partition(b"\t")
        fields = metadata.split(b" ")
        if not separator or len(fields) != 3:
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git tree row is malformed.")
        mode, kind, encoded_oid = fields
        name, oid = encoded_name.decode(), encoded_oid.decode("ascii")
        if (
            mode not in {b"100644", b"100755"}
            or kind != b"blob"
            or len(oid) != 40
            or set(oid) - set("0123456789abcdef")
            or name not in names
            or name in objects
        ):
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git member identity or type changed.")
        objects[name] = oid
    if objects.keys() != set(names):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git tree membership is incomplete.")
    raw = _git(
        root,
        "cat-file",
        "--batch",
        payload="".join(objects[name] + "\n" for name in names).encode(),
    )
    result: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    offset = 0
    for name in names:
        boundary = raw.find(b"\n", offset)
        if boundary == -1:
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob header is incomplete.")
        fields = raw[offset:boundary].split(b" ")
        if len(fields) != 3:
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob header is malformed.")
        encoded_oid, kind, size = fields
        if encoded_oid != objects[name].encode() or kind != b"blob":
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob identity or type changed.")
        if not size.isdigit() or (len(size) > 1 and size.startswith(b"0")):
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob size is not canonical.")
        start = boundary + 1
        end = start + int(size)
        if end >= len(raw) or raw[end : end + 1] != b"\n":
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob payload is incomplete.")
        content = raw[start:end]
        object_hash = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + size + b"\0", usedforsecurity=False)
        object_hash.update(content)
        if object_hash.hexdigest() != objects[name]:
            raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob bytes differ from the selected object.")
        result[name] = content
        offset = end + 1
    if offset != len(raw):
        raise ValueError("Preflight Git blob payload has trailing data.")
    return result


def read_frozen_blobs(root: Path, revision: str, names: list[str]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    """Read a literal immutable group afresh with the complete existing Git checks."""
    return _blobs(root, revision, names)


def _read(root: Path, name: str) -> bytes:
    from tests.d07_geometry_containment import read_owned_geometry_member

    if root.absolute() != root.resolve(strict=True):
        raise ValueError("Aliased preflight successor root.")

def preceding_control(root: Path, name: str, raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Exact byte projection; the complete successor freeze is admitted separately."""
    if name == "tests/code_quality/test_performance_category_migration.py":
        from tools import performance_ci60_qualification as ci60

        if (root / ci60.NAMESPACE).is_dir():
            return ci60.preceding_control(root, name, raw)
    if name not in PINS and name != ASSESSMENT:
        return raw
    actual = _read(root, name)
    if name == ASSESSMENT:
        _assessment(root, _freeze(root))
    elif _sha(_ci54_previous(root, name, actual)) != PINS[name]:
        raise ValueError(

            "Qualification / Perils successor / Preflight source: " + name
        )
    old = _history(root, "show", BASE + ":" + name)
    if raw not in (actual, old):
        raise ValueError("Preflight control caller supplied unrelated bytes.")
    return old


def assert_static_transition(name: str, before: bytes, current: bytes, row: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Check one finite static edit against its independent immutable preimage."""
    from tools.cumulative_preservation import assert_recipe

    if (
        name not in STATIC_BEFORE
        or row.keys() != {"before_sha256", "after_sha256", "recipe"}
        or row["before_sha256"] != STATIC_BEFORE[name]
        or _sha(before) != STATIC_BEFORE[name]
        or row["after_sha256"] != _sha(current)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Static transition identity or bytes changed.")
    recipe: dict[str, Any] = row["recipe"]
    if (
        not isinstance(recipe, dict)
        or recipe.keys() != {"edits"}
        or not isinstance(recipe["edits"], list)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Static transition recipe is malformed.")
    for edit in cast(list[dict[str, Any]], recipe["edits"]):
        if not isinstance(edit, dict) or "kind" not in edit:
            raise ValueError("Static transition edit is malformed.")
        kind = edit.get("kind")
        keys = {"kind", "at", "before", "after"}
        if kind == "splice":
            keys |= {"start", "end"}
        if (
            kind not in {"replace", "splice"}
            or edit.keys() != keys
            or not isinstance(edit["at"], list)
            or not edit["at"]
            or any(type(part) not in {str, int} for part in edit["at"])
        ):
            raise ValueError("Static transition edit is malformed.")
        if kind == "splice" and (
            type(edit["start"]) is not int
            or type(edit["end"]) is not int
            or not 0 <= edit["start"] <= edit["end"]
            or not isinstance(edit["before"], list)
            or not isinstance(edit["after"], list)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Static transition splice is malformed.")
    assert_recipe(before, current, recipe)

    ):

    previous = _blobs(root, STATIC_BASE, list(STATIC_BEFORE))
    for name in STATIC_BEFORE:

            name, previous[name], frozen_members[name], record["changes"][name]
        )

def _runtime_transitions(root: Path, frozen_members: dict[str, bytes]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    record: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(frozen_members[CI_RUNTIME_RECORD])

        record.keys() != {"schema", "base", "changes"}
        or record["schema"] != "exact-ci-successor-v1"
        or record["base"] != CI_RUNTIME_BASE
        or record["changes"].keys() != CI_RUNTIME_BEFORE.keys() | {CI_RUNTIME_NEW}
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI runtime membership or base changed.")
    previous = _blobs(root, CI_RUNTIME_BASE, list(CI_RUNTIME_BEFORE))
    if _history(
        root, "--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", CI_RUNTIME_BASE, "--", CI_RUNTIME_NEW
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI runtime guard predecessor was not absent.")
    for name in record["changes"]:
        assert_ci_runtime_transition(
            name, previous.get(name), frozen_members[name], record["changes"][name]
        )
    return frozen_members | previous


def _assert_ci_edits(
    before: bytes | None,
    current: bytes,
    row: dict[str, Any],
    expected: str | None,
    added: bool,
) -> None:
    if (
        row.keys() != {"before_sha256", "after_sha256", "edits"}
        or row["before_sha256"] != expected
        or (before is None) != added
        or (before is not None and _sha(before) != expected)
        or row["after_sha256"] != _sha(current)
        or not isinstance(row["edits"], list)
        or not row["edits"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI transition identity or bytes changed.")
    projected = b"" if before is None else before
    for edit in cast(list[dict[str, Any]], row["edits"]):
        if (
            not isinstance(edit, dict)
            or edit.keys() != {"before", "after"}
            or not isinstance(edit["before"], str)
            or not isinstance(edit["after"], str)
        ):
            raise ValueError("CI transition edit is malformed.")
        old, new = edit["before"].encode(), edit["after"].encode()
        if projected.count(old) != 1:
            raise ValueError("CI transition edit does not have one exact occurrence.")
        projected = projected.replace(old, new, 1)
    if projected != current:
        raise ValueError("CI transition changed outside the exact reviewed edits.")


def _ci_transitions(root: Path, frozen_members: dict[str, bytes]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    comparison = _runtime_transitions(root, frozen_members)
    transport: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(frozen_members[CI_TRANSPORT_RECORD])
    if (
        transport.keys() != {"schema", "base", "changes"}
        or transport["schema"] != "exact-ci-successor-v1"
        or transport["base"] != CI_TRANSPORT_BASE
        or transport["changes"].keys() != CI_TRANSPORT_BEFORE.keys()
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI transport membership or base changed.")
    previous = _blobs(root, CI_TRANSPORT_BASE, list(CI_TRANSPORT_BEFORE))
    for name in CI_TRANSPORT_BEFORE:
        assert_ci_transport_transition(
            name, previous[name], comparison[name], transport["changes"][name]
        )
    comparison |= previous
    record: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(frozen_members[CI_COMPAT_RECORD])
    if (
        record.keys() != {"schema", "base", "changes"}
        or record["schema"] != "exact-ci-successor-v1"
        or record["base"] != CI_COMPAT_BASE
        or record["changes"].keys() != CI_COMPAT_BEFORE.keys()
    ):
        raise ValueError("CI compatibility membership or base changed.")
    previous = _blobs(root, CI_COMPAT_BASE, list(CI_COMPAT_BEFORE))
    for name in CI_COMPAT_BEFORE:
        assert_ci_compatibility_transition(
            name, previous[name], comparison[name], record["changes"][name]
        )
    # Current bytes have already passed their immutable freeze and physical reads.
    # Only this finite comparison view feeds the unchanged earlier recipes.
    comparison |= previous
    specifications: tuple[tuple[str, str, dict[str, str], set[str]], ...] = (
        (CI_BASE, CI_RECORD, CI_BEFORE, {CI_NEW}),
        (CI_FORMAT_BASE, CI_FORMAT_RECORD, CI_FORMAT_BEFORE, set()),
    )
    for base, record_path, pins, added in specifications:
        record = json.loads(frozen_members[record_path])
        if (
            record.keys() != {"schema", "base", "changes"}
            or record["schema"] != "exact-ci-successor-v1"
            or record["base"] != base
            or record["changes"].keys() != pins.keys() | added
        ):
            raise ValueError("CI transition membership or base changed.")
        for name in added:
            if _history(root, "--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", base, "--", name):
                raise ValueError("CI bootstrap predecessor was not absent.")
        previous = _blobs(root, base, list(pins))
        for name in record["changes"]:
            assert_ci_transition(
                name, previous.get(name), comparison[name], record["changes"][name]
            )
    return comparison


def ci_comparison(root: Path, name: str, raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Authenticate a finite later edit before its unchanged earlier recipe."""
    if (
        name not in CI_COMPAT_BEFORE
        and name not in CI_TRANSPORT_BEFORE
        and name not in CI_RUNTIME_BEFORE
    ):
        return raw
    _freeze(root)
    if raw != _read(root, name):
        raise ValueError("Static comparison caller supplied unrelated bytes.")
    if name in CI_COMPAT_BEFORE:
        base, pin = CI_COMPAT_BASE, CI_COMPAT_BEFORE[name]
    elif name in CI_TRANSPORT_BEFORE:
        base, pin = CI_TRANSPORT_BASE, CI_TRANSPORT_BEFORE[name]
    else:
        base, pin = CI_RUNTIME_BASE, CI_RUNTIME_BEFORE[name]
    before = _history(root, "show", base + ":" + name)
    if _sha(before) != pin:
        raise ValueError("Static comparison immutable bytes changed.")
    return before


def static_predecessor(root: Path, name: str, raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Expose reviewed annotation, bootstrap and lookup-only test predecessors."""
    lookup_test = "tests/code_quality/test_faction_content_runtime_structure.py"
    if name not in {STATIC_TEST, QUALITY_BOOTSTRAP, lookup_test}:
        return raw
    _freeze(root)
    live = _read(root, name)
    if raw not in (live, live.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")):
        raise ValueError("Static predecessor caller supplied unrelated bytes.")
    if name == lookup_test:
        base, pin = CI_RUNTIME_BASE, CI_RUNTIME_BEFORE[name]
    elif name == STATIC_TEST:
        base, pin = STATIC_BASE, STATIC_BEFORE[name]
    else:
        base, pin = CI_COMPAT_BASE, CI_COMPAT_BEFORE[name]
    before = _history(root, "show", base + ":" + name)
    if _sha(before) != pin:
        raise ValueError("Static predecessor immutable bytes changed.")
    return before.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") if raw != live else before


def _freeze(root: Path) -> str:
    from tools.quality_runtime_successor import BORROWED_PREDECESSORS, admit

    admit(root)
    freeze = FREEZE_COMMIT
    if freeze is None or len(freeze) != 40 or set(freeze) - set("0123456789abcdef"):
        raise ValueError("Preflight successor awaits its exact source freeze.")
    _history(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", BASE, freeze)
    _git(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", freeze, "HEAD")
    _history(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", STATIC_BASE, freeze)
    _history(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", CI_BASE, freeze)
    _history(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", CI_FORMAT_BASE, freeze)
    _history(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", CI_COMPAT_BASE, freeze)
    _history(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", CI_TRANSPORT_BASE, freeze)
    _history(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", CI_RUNTIME_BASE, freeze)
    names = _history(root, "diff", "--name-only", BASE, freeze).decode().splitlines()
    if set(names) != PINS.keys() | {SELF, ASSESSMENT} or len(names) != len(PINS) + 2:
        raise ValueError("Preflight successor finite membership changed.")
    frozen_members = _blobs(root, freeze, [SELF, *PINS, *ANCHORS])
    frozen = frozen_members[SELF]
    marker = b"\nFREEZE_COMMIT: str | None = None"
    if frozen.count(marker) != 1 or _ci54_previous(root, SELF, _read(root, SELF)) != frozen.replace(
        marker, f'\nFREEZE_COMMIT: str | None = "{freeze}"'.encode(), 1
    ):
        raise ValueError("Preflight successor activation changed.")
    for name, pin in PINS.items():
        if (
            _sha(frozen_members[name]) != pin
            or _sha(
                _ci54_previous(
                    root,
                    name,
                    _read(root, name),
                    predecessor=frozen_members[name] if name in BORROWED_PREDECESSORS else None,
                )
            )
            != pin
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Reviewed migration source/data changed: "
                "Qualification / Perils successor / Preflight source: " + name
            )
    anchor_before = _blobs(root, BASE, list(ANCHORS))
    for name, pin in ANCHORS.items():
        if (
            _sha(anchor_before[name]) != pin
            or _read(root, name) != anchor_before[name]
            or frozen_members[name] != anchor_before[name]
        ):
            raise ValueError("Preflight unchanged owned anchor changed: " + name)
    comparison = _ci_transitions(root, frozen_members)
    _static_transitions(root, comparison)
    return freeze


def _assessment(root: Path, freeze: str) -> bytes:
    from tools.performance_policy import owner_hashes

    assessment = json.loads(_history(root, "show", freeze + ":" + ASSESSMENT))
    current = _ci54_previous(root, SELF, _read(root, SELF))
    change = assessment["changes"][SELF]
    change["after_sha256"] = _sha(current)
    change["owners"]["@module"]["after"] = owner_hashes(SELF, current)["@module"]
    raw_assessment = _read(root, ASSESSMENT)
    if json.loads(_ci54_previous(root, ASSESSMENT, raw_assessment)) != assessment:
        raise ValueError("Preflight assessment changed outside exact anchor derivation.")
    return raw_assessment


def current_source(root: Path, previous: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    if _sha(json.dumps(previous, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()) != BASE_SOURCE:
        raise ValueError("Preflight successor preceding complete source changed.")
    freeze = _freeze(root)
    from tools.quality_runtime_successor import current_source as ci54_source

    return ci54_source(
        root,
        previous
        | PINS
        | {SELF: _sha(_read(root, SELF)), ASSESSMENT: _sha(_assessment(root, freeze))},
    )


def measurement_inputs(root: Path, current: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Expose exact historical comparison inputs after current-source admission.

    The finite static recipes also admit the Command-end fixture's explicit
    export list; its functions, source-ID import and initializers remain exact.
    This is a changed recorded fixture input, not a byte-identical measurement.
    The CI successor also changes package bootstrap to prevent generated bytecode
    and imports the same generator function from its canonical owner. Its three
    exact module mappings add no detailed families or altered workload semantics.
    Exact later import-block edits retain all benchmark functions and constants;
    reordered imports have separate current entry-point controls.
    Current collectors and a fresh smoke receipt still bind the actual source.
    """
    from tools import thousand_sons_perils_preservation as perils
    from tools.quality_runtime_successor import measurement_inputs as ci54_inputs

    _freeze(root)
    current = ci54_inputs(root, current)
    # The audit, proof records and CI workflow are outside runtime_inputs; their
    # bytes remain authenticated by _freeze and the complete live source scan.
    controls = (
        (
            PINS.keys()
            - {
                INVENTORY,
                STATIC_RECORD,
                CI_RECORD,
                CI_FORMAT_RECORD,
                CI_COMPAT_RECORD,
                CI_TRANSPORT_RECORD,
                CI_RUNTIME_RECORD,
                CI_ROADMAP,
                CI_WORKFLOW,
            }
        )
        | ANCHORS.keys()
        | {SELF}
    )
    if not controls <= current.keys():
        raise ValueError("Preflight actual input collector omitted current inputs.")
    actual = {name: _sha(_ci54_previous(root, name, _read(root, name))) for name in controls}
    projected = dict(current)
    prior_names = set(_history(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", BASE).decode().splitlines())
    historical = _blobs(root, BASE, sorted((controls & prior_names) | perils.CHANGED))
    for name in controls:
        if name not in current:
            continue
        if current[name] != actual[name]:
            raise ValueError("Preflight actual input collector omitted current control bytes.")
        if name in prior_names:
            projected[name] = _sha(historical[name])
        else:
            del projected[name]
    # These five exact paths are already authenticated by the native Perils
    # admission. Its added test is not a measured driver or imported fixture.
    perils._freeze(root)
    for name in perils.CHANGED:
        raw = historical[name]
        if projected.get(name) != _sha(raw):
            raise ValueError("Preflight Perils producing projection changed.")
        if name in {perils.SELF, perils.GUARD}:
            del projected[name]
        elif name == perils.TEST:
            projected[name] = _sha(perils.preceding_test(root, name, _read(root, name)))
        else:
            projected[name] = _sha(perils.preceding_control(root, name, _read(root, name)))
    return projected
